jobs.description:
About Gallatin

At Gallatin, we are rebuilding logistics infrastructure for the national security missions of the United States and allied partners. We build AI systems that determine how logistics decisions are made — not just how they're executed. From factory to foxhole, we operate at the layer where data becomes decisions, and decisions make the advantage.

About The Role

We’re looking for an IT Systems Engineer to help build and scale the systems Gallatin employees rely on every day.

As the second dedicated IT hire, you will work across endpoint engineering, identity and access management, SaaS administration, security and compliance, office infrastructure, automation, and employee support. You will own systems end to end and help define how IT operates as Gallatin grows.

This is a broad systems role with a strong endpoint focus. You should be able to operate across macOS, Windows, mobile, identity, and cloud applications, with hands-on experience in Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, Google Workspace, and Okta. Experience managing Windows devices and access controls in Microsoft 365 GCC High is especially important.

The level is flexible. We care more about technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to build reliable systems than a specific title or number of years.

What You'll Do

Build and Own Endpoint Management

Own the lifecycle of Gallatin’s macOS, Windows, and mobile environments, from enrollment through deprovisioning. Build and maintain Jamf Pro policies, profiles, packages, scripts, smart groups, compliance controls, and Self Service workflows. Implement and operate Windows device management through Microsoft Intune in GCC High. Design Google Workspace mobile application management controls for employee-owned devices. Automate provisioning, application deployment, patching, security baselines, inventory, and compliance reporting.

Scale Identity and Enterprise Systems

Own identity lifecycle workflows across Okta, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 GCC High, Slack, and other business-critical platforms. Automate onboarding, role changes, access reviews, and offboarding using APIs, scripts, and workflow tools. Design access controls around least privilege, device trust, role-based access, and data sensitivity. Administer and integrate Gallatin’s core productivity, collaboration, engineering, and business applications. Establish guardrails for enterprise AI tools and AI-enabled SaaS applications, including authentication, provisioning, data handling, retention, integrations, and audit logging. Partner with Security and Engineering to protect sensitive company and government data while enabling employees to use approved AI tools productively. Replace brittle manual processes with systems that are repeatable, observable, and difficult to misuse.

Strengthen and Operate the Environment

Translate CMMC, NIST 800-171, and other requirements into technical controls that work in practice. Build reliable device compliance, access enforcement, evidence collection, and audit-readiness workflows. Troubleshoot complex issues across endpoints, identity, SaaS applications, networking, authentication, and operating systems. Provide direct employee support while eliminating recurring failure modes through engineering and automation. Create clear documentation, runbooks, standards, and employee-facing guidance. Take ownership of unfamiliar problems and drive them through resolution.

What We’re Looking For

Experience as an IT Systems Engineer, Endpoint Engineer, Systems Administrator, or in a similarly broad technical role. Strong hands-on Okta administration, including SSO, MFA, application integrations, lifecycle management, and access policies. Strong hands-on management of macOS, Windows, and mobile devices using Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, and Google Workspace. Experience operating Microsoft 365 and Intune in GCC High or another regulated Microsoft cloud environment. Ability to independently design, implement, operate, and improve production IT systems. Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, networks, identity platforms, and cloud applications. Automation skills using Bash, PowerShell, Python, APIs, or workflow platforms. Understanding of identity lifecycle management, device trust, least privilege, conditional access, and role-based access. Strong communication, documentation, and judgment in fast-moving environments. Comfort operating in a small team where ownership is broad and outcomes matter more than organizational boundaries.

Bonus Points

Endpoint privilege management and application control. Enterprise browser management, secure web gateways, or SaaS security posture management. macOS Platform SSO or Windows Hello for Business. PKI, device certificates, and certificate lifecycle management. Configuration-as-code or infrastructure-as-code for corporate IT systems.

Mission and Identity

We are building the system that enables faster, smarter logistics decisions in contested environments, and we're doing it with a team of seasoned entrepreneurs, operators, and technologists who have built and scaled solutions in this space before. We hold ourselves to an extremely high standard. We value clear thinking, direct communication, and the kind of ownership that doesn't stop until something actually works.

Our mission is to create decision advantage when the stakes are the highest. If we succeed, the system doesn't just run; it gets smarter. We're not building AI for its own sake. We're building it because faster, smarter decisions in the most demanding environments on earth can't wait. If you want to work somewhere the stakes are real and the mission is urgent — you'll fit in here.

Why Gallatin?

The logistics infrastructure that supports America's warfighters and humanitarian disaster responders is overdue for transformation, and we are building it. From defense operations to disaster response, we're solving the hardest problems that keep missions moving when it matters most. Join a team where the mission is the point.

Compensation: Gallatin offers competitive compensation commensurate with experience. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to base salary, we offer a generous equity grant, full healthcare coverage, 401k, unlimited PTO, and the perks of working in a high-caliber, mission-driven environment.

Gallatin is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

This position may require the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. The successful candidate must be able to work in a classified environment when necessary.

We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision.

Note: Due to the nature of certain government contracts held by this organization, U.S. citizenship is a requirement for all positions at Gallatin. Proof of citizenship will be required prior to employment if selected.

jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale --- unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data --- securing and protecting private information more effectively --- Elastic's complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

**What is The Role:** The Elastic Security Endpoint Protections team builds the visibility, prevention, and on-device machine learning capabilities at the core of Elastic Defend, our endpoint and SIEM security solution. We work in kernel and user mode across Windows, macOS, and Linux, against adversaries who study how to defeat what we build. Our work reaches the security community as well as the product, through original research and conference talks. We are looking for a Senior Manager who has done this work personally and can still review a design or write code. You will lead a globally distributed team and set the tone for a group that values candid feedback, collaborative learning, and mentorship.

We believe security is a team sport, and our efficacy is independently verified rather than simply claimed: in recent third-party enterprise protection testing, Elastic Security earned a perfect malware protection score with zero false alarms, the top result in the field. If you are energized by leading world-class engineers and making a measurable dent in how the industry defends the endpoint, we would love to hear from you!

**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a world-class engineering team. Guide senior research engineers across endpoint internals, prevention engineering, and machine learning. Coach career development, deliver candid feedback, own the hiring pipeline, and set new engineers up to contribute quickly.
* Own the roadmap and drive delivery. Decide where to invest in new visibility and where to deepen existing protection engines, balancing efficacy, performance, and stability across millions of endpoints. Work with product managers to define requirements and land high-quality features on release timelines.
* Connect your team's work to the rest of Elastic Security. Every event source your team adds unlocks new detection and protection capabilities across the product. Invest in the joint planning, working relationships, and shared accountability that get your team's work into customers' hands.
* Direct the team's machine learning work. Set direction on model development, training data quality, and the telemetry features those models depend on, and connect that work to the broader machine learning strategy across Elastic Security.
* Drive cross-platform protection parity. Bring the depth Elastic has on Windows to macOS and Linux, keep the team ahead of new hardware architectures, and sustain the platform vendor relationships that give you early access to emerging operating system security APIs.
* Represent the team externally. Support your engineers in presenting at conferences and publishing on Elastic Security Labs, engage with customers and partners on protection capabilities, and be a credible voice for Elastic in the endpoint security community.

**What You Bring:**

* People-leadership experience managing senior technical individual contributors on a globally distributed team. You lead with curiosity rather than authority, actively solicit feedback, and have a track record of growing people, not just shipping releases.
* You have been a practitioner. Substantial hands-on experience as a security researcher before moving into leadership: analyzing attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), building the protections that counter them, and shipping into software that runs on customer machines at scale.
* Operating system internals knowledge, in both kernel and user mode, earned hands-on rather than through oversight, and deep enough to reason about undocumented behavior and challenge a design on its technical merits. Windows depth is what we need most, with macOS or Linux close behind.
* Hands-on reverse engineering and malware analysis experience. You have done this work yourself, and can still read a disassembly, assess a research finding on its merits, and judge which threats warrant investment.
* An adversarial instinct. You anticipate how a protection will be evaded before it ships, and hold the team to designing for resilience rather than for the proof of concept in front of them.
* Clear communication skills, comfortable writing for technical and executive audiences and distilling deeply technical work for non-expert stakeholders.
* Motivation to thrive in a distributed, autonomous environment, with a genuine passion for protecting customers from real-world adversaries.
* Demonstrated experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate feature development, debug complex systems, and optimize existing codebases.
* You possess the ability to comfortably rotate across projects, collaborate across functions and teams, and seamlessly adapt to evolving team structures.

**Bonus Points:**

* Prior ownership of an EDR, EPP, or other endpoint security product.
* Personal research output: published vulnerabilities, patents, in-depth technical writing, or conference talks.
* Experience leading machine learning engineers working on security problems.
* Experience partnering with product engineering teams to take research prototypes through to GA release.
* Conference speaking experience (e.g., Black Hat, DEF CON, CODE BLUE, Virus Bulletin).
* Familiarity with the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) and Elastic Security.

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:** As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you're looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn't matter if you're just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

jobs.description:
The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond - we are known for combining personal relationships with forward-thinking solutions.

We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here!

Summary

The AI Platform Engineer designs, builds, and operates the bank’s Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio ecosystem, enabling secure and scalable AI-driven business solutions across the enterprise. This role delivers production-ready Copilot agents, custom Power Platform connectors, MCP servers, Dataverse data models, and reusable agent tools that extend Microsoft 365 Copilot to bank workflows. Through disciplined Power Platform ALM, GitHub-native delivery, and responsible AI practices, the engineer accelerates AI adoption while reducing risk and operational cost.

Duties & Responsibilities

Design, build, and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio agents—including topics, knowledge sources, generative orchestration, authentication, and content moderation—that automate enterprise workflows across the bank

Develop and maintain custom Power Platform connectors and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that securely expose internal banking systems and APIs to Copilot Studio agents and Power Platform makers

Architect and govern Dataverse solutions—tables, relationships, security roles, business rules, plug-ins, and elastic tables—serving as the system of record for Copilot Studio agents and Power Apps

Build agent tools, plug-ins, and reusable components in C# and .NET 10 to extend Copilot Studio with custom business logic, API integrations, and AI orchestration patterns (tool calling, RAG, declarative agents)

Operate Power Platform Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) at scale—managed environments, solution packaging, the ALM Accelerator, Power Platform CLI (pac), and pipelines integrated with GitHub Actions

Implement responsible AI governance—DLP policies, environment strategy, agent telemetry, evaluation harnesses, content safety, and grounding—ensuring compliance with bank security and regulatory standards

Partner with software, data, and AI engineers to integrate Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure AI Search into Power Platform and Copilot Studio solutions, including knowledge ingestion and retrieval pipelines

Mentor pro-code and citizen developers on Copilot Studio patterns, Power Platform ALM, secure coding, and AI engineering best practices; champion compliance with change management and SDLC standards

It is the responsibility of this role to take ownership of all tasks and challenges that they encounter in the operation of their assigned position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Qualifications

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; or 5+ years of equivalent experience

Minimum Experience

5+ years building enterprise solutions on Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse), including 2+ years on Microsoft Copilot Studio or comparable conversational AI / agent platforms

Licenses & Certifications

Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate, Power Platform Solution Architect Expert, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or Microsoft 365 Certified: Copilot Studio (one or more preferred)

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Microsoft Copilot Studio: agent design, topics, generative orchestration, knowledge sources, plug-ins, connectors, authentication, environment promotion, telemetry, content moderation, and evaluation

Power Platform Connectors: custom connector authoring (OpenAPI definitions), policy templates, OAuth/OIDC, certified vs custom publishing, and connector lifecycle management

Model Context Protocol (MCP): designing, building, and hosting MCP servers that expose tools, resources, and prompts to Copilot Studio and other AI clients; transport, auth, and tool discovery patterns

Dataverse design: solution-aware tables, relationships, role-based security, business rules, plug-ins, virtual tables, elastic tables, and integration with external systems

Agent tooling and patterns: custom plug-ins, declarative agents, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and agent evaluation harnesses

Power Platform ALM at scale: managed environments, solutions, ALM Accelerator, Power Platform CLI (pac), pipelines, and tenant-wide DLP and governance

C# and modern .NET (.NET 10 / C# 13, ASP.NET Core, Minimal APIs, Azure Functions) — preferred for building connectors, MCP servers, Dataverse plug-ins, and agent tools

Microsoft Azure breadth supporting AI workloads: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Functions, API Management, Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, and Application Insights

GitHub platform: Actions (reusable and matrix workflows, OIDC federation), Advanced Security, Dependabot, GitHub Copilot, and environment policies for Power Platform pipelines

Responsible AI: prompt and agent evaluation, content safety, grounding, hallucination mitigation, and Microsoft Responsible AI Standard

Security, compliance, and observability: secrets management, zero-trust networking, data classification, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Application Insights, and Power Platform admin center analytics

Physical Demands and Work Environment

Physical Demands

Ability to communicate in person, on the phone, and through electronic channels

Ability to use a computer on a frequent basis, including typing and sustained attention to a monitor

Ability to sit, walk, and/or stand for extended periods of time

Ability to bend and reach

Work Environment

Office: This position reports to a physical Company location, and the setting will be a typical office environment.

Remote or hybrid: For remote or hybrid positions, a secure and distraction-free setting is required, with a reliable internet connection (cable or fiber preferred, mobile hotspots not acceptable). Hybrid positions will report to a physical Company location, as directed by the manager, and that setting will be a typical office environment.

Work Location: 520 Gervais Street Columbia, South Carolina 29201

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disabled/veterans.

jobs.description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to support our core banking mainframe environment. In this role, you will provide technical leadership across z/OS, MQ, CICS, IMS, DB2, and Hogan technologies, driving platform stability, resiliency, and operational excellence. You will lead the resolution of complex production issues, support critical infrastructure initiatives, and help reduce operational risk through automation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. If you are passionate about solving complex technical challenges, supporting mission-critical systems, and making a meaningful impact on the financial well-being of millions of customers, you will find this role both rewarding and purpose-driven. Learn more about career areas and business divisions at https://www.wellsfargojobs.com.

In this role, you will:

Lead or participate in high level technical concepts spanning technology and business

Develop specifications for complex infrastructure systems, design and test solutions

Contribute to the testing of business, application and technical infrastructure requirements

Drive solutions to reduce recovery

Review and analyze solutions for cloud security, secrets management and key rotations

Design, code, test, debug and document programs using Agile development practices

Design complex system upgrades

Resolve troublesome trends as they develop

Develop a long range plan designed to resolve problems and prevent them from recurring

Direct the daily risk and control flow of operations, focusing on policies, procedures and work standards to ensure success

Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals

Required Qualifications:

4+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering and Solutions experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:

4+ years of experience supporting IBM z/OS mainframe environments

Strong hands-on experience with: IBM z/OS, CICS, IMS, DB2, and Mainframe and infrastructure technologies

4+ years of experience of MQ support experience

4+ years of experience building, troubleshooting, and executing JCL

Direct experience supporting Hogan applications and associated infrastructure is a plus

Strong verbal and written communication skills

Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Experience working in highly regulated financial services environments

Job Expectations:

Provide technical leadership and subject matter expertise for the Mainframe environment, ensuring platform stability, resiliency, and performance

Support, maintain, and enhance mission-critical mainframe infrastructure technologies, including z/OS, MQ, CICS, IMS, DB2, and related middleware components

Lead the troubleshooting and resolution of complex production incidents, service degradations, and critical outages impacting Hogan applications and supporting infrastructure

Participate in a rotating 24 x 7 on-call support schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, to provide rapid response and recovery for critical production incidents

Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and develop sustainable solutions that improve platform reliability and reduce operational risk

Partner closely with application development teams, production support teams, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of technology solutions

Support change management activities, including change planning, implementation, validation, and post-implementation reviews for critical banking systems

Proven ability to troubleshoot complex incidents and restore service quickly

Experience implementing monitoring, automation, and operational stability improvements

Knowledge of disaster recovery, resiliency, business continuity, and high-availability concepts

Experience reducing recurring production issues through root cause analysis and remediation

Proven track record of resolving complex technical challenges

Ability to mentor junior engineers and share institutional knowledge

Strong collaboration skills across application, platform, infrastructure, and business teams

Experience influencing technical decisions and driving operational improvements

Pay Range

Reflected is the base pay range offered for this position. Pay may vary depending on factors including but not limited to demonstrated examples of prior performance, skills, experience, or work location. Employees may also be eligible for incentive opportunities.

$87,000.00 - $140,000.00Benefits

Wells Fargo provides eligible employees with a comprehensive set of benefits, many of which are listed below. Visit Benefits - Wells Fargo Jobs for an overview of the following benefit plans and programs offered to employees.

Health benefits401(k) PlanPaid time offDisability benefitsLife insurance, critical illness insurance, and accident insuranceParental leaveCritical caregiving leaveDiscounts and savingsCommuter benefitsTuition reimbursementScholarships for dependent childrenAdoption reimbursementPosting End Date:

2 Sep 2026*Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Applicants with Disabilities

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

Drug and Alcohol Policy

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

jobs.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients--- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

**Your Role** This role is designed for a JDE professional who enjoys connecting functional Order Management, Hardware Tracking, Supply Chain, Finance, and Master Data expertise, and global or regional transformation initiatives. The position will provide visibility across enterprise data governance, business process standardization, rollouts, upgrades, and continuous improvement for JDE-enabled operations.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Master Data Management (MDM) Functional Lead with deep expertise in JD Edwards ERP to oversee and drive the management, governance, and optimization of master data within our organization. The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge of MDM best practices, with hands-on experience in implementing and supporting master data processes, workflows, and system integrations specifically within JD Edwards. The MDM Functional Lead will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity, while providing functional guidance and support for the ongoing evolution of master data processes to meet business needs.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead the functional design and implementation of Master Data Management (MDM) processes within JD Edwards, ensuring data consistency, accuracy, and integrity across the organization. Including item, customer, supplier, product, inventory, sales order, purchasing, and manufacturing-related master data touchpoints where applicable.
* Act as the primary point of contact for MDM strategy, governance, and best practices within the JD Edwards ERP ecosystem, ensuring alignment with global business requirements.
* Define and document data management standards, processes, and workflows for key master data domains, including customers, suppliers, materials, and products within JD Edwards. Extend the scope to distribution, supply chain, inventory, sales order management, purchasing, manufacturing, and finance data touchpoints that depend on accurate and governed master data.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders (e.g., supply chain, finance, IT) to understand business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for MDM solutions. Strong cross-functional facilitation translating business needs into practical JDE functional designs.
* Configure and maintain master data processes within JD Edwards, including data creation, updates, and deletions, ensuring seamless integration between JD Edwards and other systems.
* Ensure data governance, quality, and compliance by implementing controls, policies, and procedures for managing master data in alignment with organizational objectives.
* Lead the data migration efforts for master data when migrating from legacy systems into JD Edwards, ensuring data integrity and completeness.
* Develop and maintain MDM reporting and analytics within JD Edwards to track master data health and compliance with established standards.
* Manage the integration of JD Edwards with other systems (e.g., CRM, PLM, third-party applications) to ensure master data flows seamlessly across the enterprise.
* Collaborate with the technical team to define and manage integration points, ensuring accurate and efficient data synchronization between JD Edwards and external systems.
* Contribute functional and technical JDE expertise to reporting, development-tool related analysis, issue resolution, and data-related enhancements, partnering with technical teams when required.
* Provide Subject Matter Expert leadership across JD Edwards EnterpriseOne/World environments, helping translate lessons learned from global and regional deployments into scalable MDM practices.
* Partner on project planning and execution activities using structured delivery practices and collaboration tools to support on-time milestones, stakeholder alignment, and business readiness.
* Provide functional support and training to business users, ensuring effective usage of the MDM processes within JD Edwards and driving continuous improvements.
* Ensure compliance with internal standards and regulatory requirements regarding master data management, ensuring that all data is maintained in a secure, compliant, and auditable manner.
* Lead initiatives for data quality improvements, identifying areas for enhancement, automating processes where possible, and optimizing data-related workflows to support business decision-making. Use hands-on reporting and analytical experience to make master data quality, compliance, and process adoption visible to business and IT stakeholders.
* Manage MDM projects, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure on-time and on-budget delivery of MDM-related initiatives.
* Provide practical end-user training, hypercare support, and process coaching to drive adoption and sustainable improvements across regions.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Data Management, or a related field.
* At least 5 years of hands-on experience working with JD Edwards ERP, specifically in the management of master data across multiple domains (customers, suppliers, products, etc.).
* Proven expertise in Master Data Management practices, including data governance, data quality, and data integration within an ERP environment.
* Experience with JD Edwards 9.2 or later versions, including the configuration and management of master data modules.
* Ability to create functional specifications for system requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions for MDM processes.
* Proven track record in data migration, ensuring the successful transition of data from legacy systems to JD Edwards ERP.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks and industry best practices for maintaining master data integrity and quality.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to assess the quality of master data and implement solutions to address data issues.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical teams.
* Experience in project management, particularly in leading MDM-related projects or ERP system upgrades and enhancements.
* Knowledge of data analytics and reporting tools to monitor and improve master data quality and compliance.
* Ability to provide functional training and support to end-users, helping them understand the importance of master data and ensuring adoption of MDM practices.
* Experience with data cleansing, enrichment, and validation processes, with the ability to identify and resolve data quality issues proactively.
* A solid understanding of data security and compliance requirements related to master data management.

jobs.description:
Systems Engineer IV - Endpoint Management

Phoenix, Arizona (Hybrid)

Full-Time

Job Description

Overview

The Senior Mobile Endpoint Systems Engineer leads the strategy, design, deployment, and ongoing management of enterprise mobile and endpoint solutions across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android platforms. This role is the primary subject matter expert for Mobile Device Management (MDM), Mobile Application Management (MAM), and zero-touch device enrollment programs. You will define BYOD, COPE, and COBO policies, enforce mobile security and compliance posture, and collaborate closely with the security team on zero-trust endpoint strategy. In addition, you will mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement across the endpoint lifecycle.

The role reports to our Store Support Office in Phoenix, AZ, with a hybrid work arrangement requiring in-office presence Tuesday through Thursday.

Overview of Responsibilities

Design, deploy, and manage enterprise MDM/MAM platforms (Microsoft Intune, Kandji/SOTI) with a primary focus on mobile fleet management across iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS.

Architect and administer zero-touch enrollment programs including Apple Business Manager (ABM/DEP), Android Enterprise (Zero-Touch) and Windows Autopilot.

Implement, and enforce BYOD, COPE, and COBO device policies aligned with corporate security standards and regulatory requirements.

Design and manage mobile app protection policies, app configuration profiles, and conditional access policies via Microsoft Intune and Entra ID.

Collaborate with the security team to enforce zero-trust endpoint principles, including device compliance, identity-based access, and continuous monitoring.

Manage endpoint security controls, patch management, software deployment, and compliance policy frameworks across all device types.

Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across the endpoint stack (hardware, OS, application, MDM policy) including escalated tier 3 incidents.

Perform root cause analysis on endpoint and mobile incidents and implement corrective and preventive measures.

Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for mobile/endpoint architecture, enrollment procedures, policy configurations, and operational runbooks.

Provide leadership, coaching, and mentoring to junior engineers and support staff; act as a technical escalation point across the endpoint practice.

Evaluate emerging mobile and endpoint technologies, vendors, and industry trends; provide recommendations to leadership.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience.

5+ years in endpoint engineering or device management roles, with at least 2 years focused on mobile endpoint management (Android at scale).

Deep proficiency with MDM/MAM platforms: Microsoft Intune (required), Kandji, and/or SOTI.

Hands-on experience with Apple Business Manager (ABM), Android Enterprise and Windows Autopilot enrollment programs.

Strong understanding of Conditional Access, Entra ID (Azure AD) device compliance, and app protection policies.

Proficiency in scripting and automation: PowerShell (required), Bash, and/or Python for endpoint lifecycle automation.

Solid understanding of BYOD, COPE, and COBO program design, legal/privacy considerations, and policy enforcement.

Familiarity with endpoint security frameworks (CIS Benchmarks, NIST, DISA STIGs) and patch management best practices.

Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and written/verbal communication skills.

Core Competencies

Mobile-First Mindset: Approaches endpoint strategy with mobile as a primary platform, not an afterthought.

Security Orientation: Integrates security thinking into every aspect of device and application lifecycle management.

Communication: Clearly conveys technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders; actively listens and collaborates.

Customer Focus: Prioritizes end-user experience and business needs while maintaining security and compliance standards.

Driving for Results: Sets measurable goals, pursues continuous improvement, and delivers outcomes with a sense of urgency.

Positive Approach: Demonstrates a constructive attitude in challenging situations and inspires others with a forward-looking outlook.

jobs.description:
Role: Infrastructure Engineer (Server & VMware)

Type: Contract, 6-12 months, with potential for hire

Location: Hybrid in Euclid, Ohio

Eligibility: US Permanent Residency is required for this role

Summary

The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for executing security hardening, vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure security improvement initiatives across the organization's global server environment, operating within a predominantly Windows and VMware-based enterprise environment. This role serves as a dedicated technical resource within the infrastructure team, partnering closely with Cyber Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Operations teams to reduce security exposure and improve the overall security posture of the enterprise.

The position focuses on hands-on execution of remediation activities, secure configuration management, operating system hardening, patch management, Active Directory security improvements, and infrastructure security projects. The successful candidate must be capable of operating in a large-scale enterprise environment while balancing security requirements with operational stability and up-time expectations.

Qualifications and Required Skills

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.5+ years of experience supporting enterprise server and infrastructure environments.Strong experience with Windows Server administration and security hardening.Experience with Active Directory administration, Group Policy, and privileged access management.Experience performing vulnerability remediation and security hardening activities.Familiarity with patch management solutions such as SCCM/MECM, ManageEngine, or similar tools.Experience supporting VMware-based environments.PowerShell scripting and automation skills.Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.Ability to work closely with Infrastructure and Cyber Security teams to drive remediation efforts.Linux administration experience.Experience applying CIS Benchmarks or security best practices.Exposure to vulnerability management tools.Azure or hybrid cloud experience.

Key Responsibilities

Execute server and infrastructure hardening activities aligned with CIS Benchmarks, industry standards, and corporate security requirements.Perform vulnerability remediation across Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, virtualization, and related infrastructure platforms.Partner with Cyber Security teams to evaluate vulnerabilities, prioritize remediation efforts, and drive closure of security findings.Deploy and maintain secure system configurations through standardization and baseline enforcement.Identify, remediate, and reduce unnecessary services, ports, protocols, and privileged access across server environments.Support enterprise patch management activities for operating systems and infrastructure applications.Collaborate with application owners and business teams to coordinate remediation efforts while minimizing operational impact.Assist with Active Directory security initiatives, including privilege management, group policy remediation, tiered administration, and identity security improvements.Support remediation activities resulting from vulnerability assessments, penetration tests, audits, and security reviews.Assist with implementation of security controls and compliance-related initiatives.Work within VMware environments to coordinate guest OS hardening, lifecycle management, patching, and vulnerability resolution.Develop automation scripts and operational efficiencies using PowerShell and other automation tools.Maintain accurate documentation of technical procedures, remediation activities, security configurations, and operational standards.Participate in incident response activities related to server and infrastructure security events when required.Provide technical recommendations to improve infrastructure security, operational efficiency, and platform resilience.Support additional infrastructure and security initiatives as assigned.

Wright Technical Services and our client are Equal Opportunity Employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status

jobs.description:
Tulzi Technologies, LLC (Tulzi) prides ourselves on an open, and honest culture in the workplace which builds a morale conducive to inspiring growth on our team, while balancing lifestyle by supporting personal and family goals with flexibility. Tulzi offers secure network systems and software engineering solutions in both public and private sectors. With certified expert consulting the team at Tulzi is able to address the customers mission, and follow through in the systems development life cycle.

Clearance Required: TS/SCI

Title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer

Location: Columbia, MD

The Senior Infrastructure Engineer serves as the technical lead for the organization's enterprise infrastructure, responsible for the architecture, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of compute, storage, network, virtualization, and identity management platforms. This position provides strategic and operational leadership for critical infrastructure services across a variety of classified networks, establishes engineering standards, drives modernization initiatives, and ensures the reliability, security, and scalability of systems supporting customer operations. The role requires extensive hands-on technical expertise, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to lead complex projects and maintenance activities in a secure enterprise environment.
Responsibilities include:
Design, implement, administer, and maintain enterprise infrastructure systems including Cisco UCS, Microsoft Active Directory, enterprise storage platforms, Windows Server environments, and core network infrastructure.
Architect, deploy, and support network solutions including routing, switching, segmentation, and secure communications across multiple classified environments.
Develop and maintain infrastructure standards, engineering best practices, system baselines, and technical roadmaps.
Lead infrastructure modernization efforts, technology refresh projects, migrations, and lifecycle management activities.
Manage enterprise storage solutions, data protection strategies, backups, disaster recovery capabilities, and capacity planning initiatives.
Administer enterprise identity and authentication services including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and file services.
Plan and execute system upgrades, firmware updates, patches, maintenance activities, and change management procedures.
Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions to improve operational stability and performance.
Collaborate with cybersecurity personnel to ensure compliance with security requirements, vulnerability remediation efforts, STIG implementation, and system hardening activities.
Evaluate emerging technologies and provide technical recommendations for infrastructure improvements and future-state architectures.
Develop and maintain technical documentation including architectures, diagrams, procedures, standards, and operational runbooks.
Provide senior-level technical guidance and mentoring to infrastructure personnel and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
Support planned after-hours maintenance windows and emergency response efforts to maintain system availability and operational readiness.
Requirements:
10+ years of progressive experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-scale infrastructure environments, including compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and identity services.
Expert-level knowledge of Cisco UCS infrastructure, including architecture, administration, lifecycle management, firmware maintenance, capacity planning, and performance optimization in highly available enterprise environments.
Strong experience with enterprise virtualization platforms, including VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent technologies supporting mission-critical workloads.
Advanced experience designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise network infrastructure, including LAN/WAN, routing, switching, segmentation, and network security best practices.Demonstrated ability to architect and establish enterprise infrastructure standards, develop technical roadmaps, evaluate emerging technologies, and lead infrastructure modernization initiatives aligned with business objectives.
Extensive hands-on experience administering Microsoft Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file services, authentication systems, and enterprise identity management solutions.
Strong experience managing enterprise storage platforms, including SAN, NAS, backup, disaster recovery, replication, capacity planning, and data protection strategies.
Advanced understanding of Windows server operating systems, including system hardening, patch management, performance tuning, automation, and lifecycle management.
Experience leading infrastructure maintenance and operational activities within production environments, including change management, patching, upgrades, disaster recovery testing, and after-hours maintenance windows.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical projects from design through implementation, collaborating across technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure successful delivery and operational readiness.
Expert troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform root cause analysis, resolve critical infrastructure issues, and develop long-term corrective actions for enterprise systems.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity principles and infrastructure security practices, including vulnerability remediation, system hardening, access controls, compliance requirements, and secure infrastructure design.
Experience developing technical documentation, operational procedures, infrastructure standards, and architectural diagrams to support enterprise governance and knowledge management.
Proven ability to serve as a senior technical leader and mentor, providing guidance to engineers, establishing best practices, and driving continuous improvement across infrastructure operations.
Security Clearance Required:

TS / SCI

Minimum Education:

High School Diploma or equivalent

Minimum Years of Experience:

10+years of progressive experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-scale infrastructure environments, including compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and identity services.

Required Certifications:
Required IAT Level 3 Certs: one or more of the following: CISM, CISSP, or equivalent senior-level baseline certification
Required vendor certification in one or more relevant technologies (e.g., Microsoft, VMware, Cisco, NetApp, Pure Storage, HP, Dell, Linux+, Red Hat, HBSS, ACAS). Candidates without an active certification must obtain at least one within 6 months of hire
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelors Degree
Experience supporting Federal Government, DoD, or regulated environments.
Experience with NIST RMF, NIST 800-53, STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, or equivalent compliance frameworks.
Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or other enterprise virtualization platforms.
Experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
Prior Military experience

Benefits:

We offer a competitive benefits and compensation package and FUN place to work! Benefits include, but not limited to:

Health and Wellness Benefits

Medical Insurance (three CareFirst healthcare plans to choose from, Dental and Vision Insurance, 75% covered for employee/ 50% per dependant

Health Savings Account (HSA) contributions $1500 individual/ $3000 family

Personal Insurance Benefits

Company-paid Life Insurance and AD&D coverage

Company-paid Short-term and Long-term Disability Insurance

Paid Leave

Employees receive 20 days of vacation/10 holidays built into hourly rate/ 5 days of Administrative time (currently used for snow, jury, bereavement)

Retirement

Pre-tax 401k program including 6% company match

100% fully vested from eligibility date

Eligible after 90 days of employment
Tulzi Technologies provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, pregnancy, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.description:
WHAT IS BOX?

Box(NYSE: BOX)は インテリジェントコンテンツ管理（ICM）プラットフォームのリーディングカンパニーです。Boxのプラットフォームは、企業のコラボレーション促進や、コンテンツのライフサイクル全体の管理、重要なコンテンツの保護、そしてエンタープライズAIによるビジネスワークフローの変革を実現することを目指しています。2005年に米国で設立され、JLL、モルガン・スタンレーなどを含む大手グローバル企業や、日本では23,000社超および日経225の86%の企業の業務効率化を支援しています。

Boxは、カリフォルニア州レッドウッドシティーに本社を置き、米国、ヨーロッパ、アジアにも拠点を持っています。株式会社Box Japanは2013年に設立された日本法人です。

Boxでは、重要なコンテンツを扱うプラットフォームをさらに推進し、お客様の働き方に大きな変革を提供する、またとない機会があります。コンテンツは私達の業務の中心にあります。契約書、請求書、社員情報、財務情報、製品仕様、マーケティング資産などの部署間に跨る重要なビジネス・プロセスに含まれる数十億ものファイルや情報が日々流れています。私達のミッションは、コンテンツ管理にインテリジェンスをもたらし、お客様がデジタル・トランスフォーメーションを実現するお手伝いをさせていただくことです。このAIと膨大な業務コンテンツの融合による、大規模な働き方の変革期に、そのビジネスの最前線に貢献することが、Boxではできます。

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU

Box Japan は、日本企業のコンテンツ活用と AI 活用を次のステージへ進めるフェーズにあります。 Enterprise Solutions Engineer は、経営・ IT ・現場それぞれの課題を理解し、 Box のプラットフォーム価値を業務成果に結びつける技術パートナーです。

西日本エリアの民間大手企業（従業員数2000名以上）を担当するEnterprise Solutions Engineeringチーム の一員として、営業、カスタマーサクセス、プロフェッショナルサービス、パートナーと連携し、構想策定から技術検証、導入、定着・拡張までお客様の変革を支援します。

- 経営／業務課題に紐づくデモ、ワークショップ、テクニカルディスカッション

- PoC 、パイロット、アーキテクチャ設計、価値検証のリード

- RFP 対応、セキュリティ・コンプライアンス監査、 AI 利用ガバナンスの支援

- お客様の声をプロダクトマネジメント／エンジニアリングへ届け、改善を推進

単なる製品説明ではなく、コンテンツを起点に AI ・ワークフロー・セキュリティを組み合わせ、お客様の意思決定、業務効率、リスク低減をどう実現するかを描くポジションです。

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Enteprise顧客の 経営層、 IT 部門、業務部門、パートナーとの対話を通じて課題と成功指標を整理し、技術的な知見を交えた提案を行う

- Box AI、AI エージェント、 AI Studio 、検索／ Deep Research 、データ抽出、ワークフロー自動化を含むユースケースを設計し、デモ・ワークショップ・提案資料・プレゼンテーションに落とし込む

- Microsoft 365／Teams、Salesforce、Google Workspace、Slack、ServiceNow 等の業務アプリや、お客様のカスタムアプリケーションとの連携を設計・支援する

- コンテンツの分類、アクセス制御、脅威対策、監査、データレジデンシーなど、 Enterprise のセキュリティ／ガバナンス要件に沿った提案を行う

- 担当営業、 CSM 、コンサルタント、パートナーとアカウントチームを組み、導入後の定着・利活用・拡張まで見据えた計画と実行をリードする

- API、SDK、MCP 等の開発者向け機能やエコシステムを活用し、 Box をお客様の業務基盤・ AI 基盤に組み込むための技術支援を行う

Box ではコミュニティと対面でのコラボレーションを重要視していてます。Box の社員（Boxers）は、少なくとも毎週3日間以上はオフィスで勤務することが求められます。選考プロセスの中で、リクルーターが働き方や企業文化についてさらに詳しくご説明します。

WHO YOU ARE

私たちは「AIファースト」の企業です。
すなわち、常に成長マインドセットを持ちながら仕事に取り組み、AIを活用し、より迅速かつ適切な意思決定を行い、インパクトを高める方法を見つけていくことが求められます。

- 5 年以上の IT 業界経験、かつ 2 年以上のプリセールス、ソリューションアーキテクト、 IT コンサルティング、またはプロジェクトマネジメント経験

- クラウド、 SaaS 、インフラ、アプリケーション、データ、セキュリティのいずれかに関する実務知識

- お客様の曖昧な課題を構造化し、価値仮説、技術アーキテクチャ、導入ステップまで自ら描ける方

- API、OAuth／SSO、SaaS 連携、ワークフロー自動化、生成 AI／AI エージェントに関する知識または強い関心

- 大手企業への提案、複数ステークホルダーとの合意形成、またはパートナー／アライアンス協業の経験

- ビジネス使用が可能な流暢レベル以上の日本語力

- 読み書き可能レベル以上の英語力

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation.

For details on how we protect your information when you apply, please see our Personnel Privacy Notice.

Box ではコミュニティと対面でのコラボレーションを重要視していてます。Box の社員（Boxers）は、少なくとも毎週3日間以上はオフィスで勤務することが求められます。選考プロセスの中で、リクルーターが働き方や企業文化についてさらに詳しくご説明します。

jobs.title: Técnico/a SCCM/INTUNE
jobs.summary: Buscamos un Técnico/a de Administración de Endpoints con al menos 3 años de experiencia en entornos Microsoft Endpoint Management, especializado en SCCM (Microsoft Configuration Manager) e Intune. Será responsable de la administración, mantenimiento y...
jobs.description:
Buscamos un Técnico/a de Administración de Endpoints con al menos 3 años de experiencia en entornos Microsoft Endpoint Management, especializado en SCCM (Microsoft Configuration Manager) e Intune. Será responsable de la administración, mantenimiento y evolución de la plataforma de gestión de dispositivos, garantizando el despliegue seguro y eficiente de sistemas operativos, aplicaciones y políticas corporativas. Las funciones están alineadas con actividades de despliegue, empaquetado, distribución de software y gestión del ciclo de vida del puesto de trabajo identificadas en documentación interna.

Las responsabilidades principales del puesto son las siguientes:

* Administración y soporte de plataformas SCCM y Microsoft Intune.
* Gestión del ciclo de vida de dispositivos Windows.
* Despliegue y distribución de aplicaciones mediante SCCM e Intune.
* Creación, validación y mantenimiento de paquetes de software.
* Administración de políticas de configuración y cumplimiento (Compliance Policies).
* Implementación y mantenimiento de Configuration Profiles.
* Gestión de Windows Update for Business y despliegue de actualizaciones.
* Soporte en proyectos de migración de SCCM hacia Intune y Modern Workplace.
* Diagnóstico y resolución de incidencias relacionadas con la gestión de endpoints.
* Automatización de tareas mediante PowerShell.
* Elaboración y mantenimiento de documentación técnica.
* Coordinación con equipos de soporte, seguridad y workplace.

Requisitos obligatorios

Experiencia

* Mínimo 3 años administrando SCCM y/o Microsoft Intune.
* Experiencia en despliegue de aplicaciones y sistemas operativos.
* Experiencia en troubleshooting de entornos Windows empresariales.
* Experiencia en gestión de inventario hardware y software.

Conocimientos técnicos

* Microsoft SCCM / MECM.
* Microsoft Intune.
* Microsoft Endpoint Manager.
* Windows 10 y Windows 11.
* Azure AD / Entra ID.
* Microsoft 365.
* PowerShell.
* Gestión de GPOs y su transición a políticas modernas de Intune.
* Compliance Policies y Security Baselines.
* Conocimientos de Autopilot (muy valorables).

Requisitos valorables

* Experiencia en proyectos de migración SCCM → Intune.
* Conocimientos de Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Certificaciones Microsoft:
*

* MD-102 Endpoint Administrator.

* AZ-104 Azure Administrator.

* MS-102 Microsoft 365 Administrator.
* Experiencia en integración con ServiceNow.
* Conocimientos de Nexthink u otras soluciones DEX.

Competencias personales

* Capacidad analítica y de resolución de problemas.
* Orientación al cliente y al servicio.
* Capacidad de documentación y organización.
* Trabajo en equipo y colaboración multidisciplinar.
* Proactividad e iniciativa.
* Capacidad para trabajar en entornos internacionales.

Perfil ideal

Profesional con experiencia sólida en la administración de SCCM e Intune, habituado a gestionar grandes volúmenes de dispositivos corporativos, despliegues masivos de software, automatización mediante PowerShell y proyectos de modernización del puesto de trabajo basados en Microsoft 365 y Endpoint Management.

jobs.title: Analista de Segurança da Informação - foco em Endpoint (Operação)
jobs.summary: **Sobre a empresa:** Há 20 anos, a XSITE atua com soluções em Segurança da Informação, ajudando empresas a proteger seus ambientes digitais com inteligência, zelo e conexão. Mais do que integrar produtos e serviços, cultivamos relações de confiança com...
jobs.description:
**Sobre a empresa:** Há 20 anos, a XSITE atua com soluções em Segurança da Informação, ajudando empresas a proteger seus ambientes digitais com inteligência, zelo e conexão.

Mais do que integrar produtos e serviços, cultivamos relações de confiança com nossos clientes. Chamamos esse espaço de Território de Proteção: um ambiente onde a segurança da informação permite que as empresas trabalhem com tranquilidade, foco e produtividade.

Nosso propósito é simples e poderoso: proporcionar paz para o ambiente corporativo.

Nossa cultura é inspirada no conceito Teknoporã, uma adaptação do "bem viver", que conecta tecnologia, equilíbrio e colaboração. Acreditamos em relações de parceria, respeito e confiança, dentro e fora da empresa.

Aqui, nos vemos como uma tribo de guardiões digitais, profissionais que unem conhecimento, atitude e conexão para proteger o ambiente digital dos nossos clientes com leveza, responsabilidade e excelência técnica.

Se você acredita que tecnologia também pode ser humana, colaborativa e feita com propósito, a XSITE pode ser o seu lugar 🌳✨

**Descrição da vaga:** Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados que queiram se desenvolver na área de Segurança da Informação e evoluir sua carreira em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo!

Foco da vaga: Endpoint Security para atuar na proteção de estações de trabalho e servidores contra ameaças avançadas, no nosso time de Operações (MSSP/SOC).

**Principais Atividades**

* Gerenciamento e Proteção de Endpoints:
* Administração e configuração de soluções de segurança para endpoints (EPP, EDR, XDR).
* Monitoramento e resposta a incidentes relacionados a malwares, ransomware e ameaças avançadas.
* Aplicação de políticas de segurança para controle de acesso, firewall local e regras de execução de aplicações.
* Gerenciamento de soluções como Cortex XDR, CrowdStrike, Trellix, FortiClient, entre outras.
* Investigação e mitigação de incidentes de segurança em endpoints corporativos.
* Detecção e Resposta a Ameaças:
* Implementação de estratégias de Threat Hunting e análise de comportamento de ameaças.
* Uso de ferramentas de SIEM/SOAR para correlacionar eventos e automatizar respostas a incidentes.
* Análise e criação de regras personalizadas para aumentar a eficácia das soluções de segurança.
* Gerenciamento de Vulnerabilidades e Correção:
* Aplicação de melhores práticas de hardening em sistemas operacionais Windows, Linux e macOS.
* Análise e priorização de vulnerabilidades detectadas em endpoints, alinhando-se a frameworks como MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Suporte na implementação de políticas de patch management e controle de versões de software.
* Controle de Acesso e Proteção de Identidades:
* Integração de soluções de segurança de endpoints com ferramentas de Identity \& Access Management (IAM).
* Aplicação de políticas de Zero Trust para minimizar riscos de credenciais comprometidas.
* Monitoramento de acessos suspeitos e prevenção de movimentações laterais dentro da rede.

**Principais Requisitos**

* Graduação completa na área de TI;
* Experiência na administração de soluções de Endpoint Security;
* Conhecimento em proteção contra ameaças avançadas e resposta a incidentes;
* Experiência com soluções de EPP, EDR e XDR;
* Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança como MITRE ATT\&CK, NIST e CIS Controls;
* Capacidade de trabalhar com diferentes ferramentas de segurança de ponta.

**Jornada De Trabalho**

* Segunda a sexta-feira das 08h às 17h (com 1 hora de intervalo);
* Presencial nos 3 primeiros meses (a partir do 4º mês, híbrido).

**Benefícios**

* - Cartão flexível (uso livre): Alimentação: R$ 32,14/dia + Transporte: R$ 23,60/dia;
* - Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (Cobertura de 70% para o colaborador titular e 50% para o primeiro dependente);
* - Auxílio Internet;
* - Bonificação mensal (baseada no Plano de Conformidade Operacional);
* - Premiação trimestral (OKR);
* - Planejamento de capacitação e certificações;
* - Incentivo ao curso de inglês (50%);
* - Plano de Carreira.

Salário: a combinar

Contrato: CLT (Efetivo)

jobs.title: MDM Sales Manager – Tijuana (M/F)
jobs.summary: With 1,700 employees and 14 factories across 3 continents, STERIMED is the world's leading manufacturer of materials and packaging systems for the sterilization of medical devices. Sterimed develops, produces, converts, and markets various solutions such...
jobs.description:
With 1,700 employees and 14 factories across 3 continents, STERIMED is the world's leading manufacturer of materials and packaging systems for the sterilization of medical devices. Sterimed develops, produces, converts, and markets various solutions such as bacterial barrier substrates and preformed sterilization packaging, serving both hospitals and medical device manufacturers.

Sterimed stands out with its strong entrepreneurial DNA and has been pursuing a highly dynamic external growth policy for several years. Since its founding in 2016, the group's size has quadrupled, and 10 acquisitions have been completed since 2017.

To support this growth, we are looking for a Sales Manager M/F for our MDM business. Reporting to the MDM Sales Team Leader Americas, the role will be responsible for managing, developing, and closing profitable new business across Tijuana, the Mexican maquiladora, and the U.S. West Coast. This is a remote role based in Tijuana, Mexico.

The primary focus of this role is selling medical packaging solutions to medical device manufacturers while also managing and expanding an existing portfolio of strategic customer accounts. In addition to new busi-ness development, the role has a strong key account management dimension, ensuring long-term custom-er growth, satisfaction, and partnership. To successfully manage this portfolio, the Sales Manager fosters alignment and effective collaboration across the regional sales organization.

This position requires a strong commercial mindset, excellent prospecting skills, and the ability to convert business opportunities into sustainable and profitable orders. The Sales Manager works closely with cus-tomers, internal technical teams, and key stakeholders to support product validation, strengthen strategic customer relationships, identify growth opportunities within existing accounts, and drive order intake and market expansion.

The ideal candidate will be a collaborative and transparent team player who can operate successfully in a multicultural, cross-border environment. This role also requires strong project management skills, the ability to build annual sales forecasts and budgets, and a commitment to delivering results in a dynamic, international business setting.

The position involves frequent travel throughout the assigned territory, including Tijuana, Mexico, the Mexican maquiladora, and the U.S. West Coast, as well as occasional travel to France for company seminars and business meetings.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

• Grow sales within the assigned territory of Tijuana, the Mexican maquiladora, and the U.S. West Coast.

• Develop new business opportunities with medical device manufacturers.

• Manage and expand an existing customer portfolio.

• Prospect actively to identify and convert new commercial opportunities.

• Support product validation projects in coordination with customers and the technical department.

• Act as the link between customers and internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication and follow-up.

• Turn business opportunities into profitable orders.

• Build annual sales budgets based on customer forecasts and new business opportunities.

• Maintain accurate reporting and CRM updates.

• Apply company marketing and commercial policies consistently.

• Travel regularly within the territory and occasionally internationally as required.

**Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Business Negotiation, Packaging En-gineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an export sales or B2B sales position.

• Experience in medical sterile packaging is preferred; experience in general packaging or food packaging will also be considered.

• Strong understanding of sales processes, customer development, and account management.

• Experience working with technical or project-based sales cycles is an asset.

**Skills and Competencies**

• Strong prospecting and business development skills.

• Excellent negotiation and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and customer projects simultaneously.

• Strong reporting, planning, and forecasting capabilities.

• Proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM tools.

• Knowledge of Incoterms is preferred.

• Able to work effectively in an international and multicultural environment.

• Customer-focused, proactive, self-driven, and results-oriented.

• Strong relationship-building and problem-solving abilities.

• Adaptable and eager to learn about a new industry or market segment.

**Language Requirement**

• Bilingual in English and Spanish is required.

**Travel Requirement**

• Travel approximately 50% to 70% of the time within the assigned territory.

• Occasional travel outside of territory but within the Americas and France for company seminars or business meetings.

*Sterimed is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible work environment. Feel free to let us know about any accommodations you may need to participate in the recruitment process.*

jobs.summary: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to...
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .

As a Senior IT Support Engineer on the IT Tooling team within IT Support & Services (ITSS), you'll own the technical architecture behind the automations that power IT operations at Coinbase. This team builds the self-service workflows, bots, and integrations that employees interact with daily, from ticket triage and access reviews to onboarding and offboarding. You'll drive architecture decisions across platforms like n8n, Airflow, Temporal, Jira, and Okta, partnering with regional IT teams across APAC, EMEA, and AMER to deliver high-impact automation at scale.

What you’ll do:

- Own the technical architecture of IT Tooling automations, driving design decisions on system structure, integration patterns, and platform standards across n8n, Airflow, Temporal, and Jira

- Lead the most complex automation projects end-to-end as technical DRI, from discovery and design through production delivery

- Partner with Security, Corporate Engineering, and IAM teams to resolve technical blockers and represent IT Tooling in cross-functional architecture discussions

- Build shared frameworks, reusable components, and architecture documentation that reduce single points of failure and raise the team's engineering bar

- Establish code review practices and engineering standards that elevate quality across the IT Tooling platform

Required skills and experience:

- 5+ years in IT engineering, automation, or systems engineering, with demonstrated ownership of architecture decisions and platform-level systems others build on top of

- Deep expertise building and maintaining complex automations with n8n, Airflow, Temporal, Jira Automation, or Workato, plus strong Git-based development workflows (branching, CI/CD, code review)

- Working knowledge of Okta, Slack API, and Google Workspace administration sufficient to design secure, scalable automation architecture

- Proven ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments, translating loosely scoped problems into production-ready technical specs and clear architecture decision records

- Experience mentoring peers and writing technical design documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences

- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about finding innovative solutions to complex technical problems , running countless experiments (300+ at a time!) with our massive user base to make data-driven decisions, and educating our users and employees alike. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities, mentorship and collaboration with world-class minds, and a variety of projects with large scopes — while doing work that’s both fun and meaningful.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

About the role...

As an Android engineer on our Application Stability and Performance team you’ll own the stability and performance of the Duolingo Android Learning app for millions of learners.

This team builds the tooling other engineers depend on to keep the app performant like AI agent driven crash and memory analysis, coroutine system tracing, and Macrobenchmark suites that catch regressions before they ship. You'll also own the performance metrics that feed into our experiment analyses and help ensure hundreds of concurrent experiments surface any performance issues or regressions.

🧠 You will...

- Lead architectural initiatives to fix the slowest parts of the app, from startup to critical learning flows

- Own and evolve our performance tooling with tracing, benchmarking, and automated regression detection

- Serve as a bridge between Client Platform and Product feature teams, helping them understand and act on the performance data we provide

- Foster a culture of engineering excellence around performance and mentor engineers of all experience levels

✅ You have...

- Worked on and shipped large scale Android applications

- Experience identifying the root cause and resolving ANRs, memory leaks, dropped frames, and complex crashes

- Strong Kotlin skills and deep familiarity with coroutines, Jetpack Compose, and modern architecture patterns

- Experience optimizing startup time, memory, and network usage for low-memory devices

- Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for tackling difficult challenges

⭐ Exceptional candidates will have...

- Expertise in Android tracing tooling like the AndroidX Tracing Library and Perfetto

- Experience with crash observability tooling like Sentry and Android Vitals

The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!

Salary Range:

$182,800 - $247,300 USD

Benefits: Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well-being with our benefits here .

Job Alerts: Sign up for job alerts here .

Accommodations: We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com .

Equal Employment Opportunity: Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Fraud Warning: Unfortunately, there is a rise in scammers pretending to be real Duolingo employees. Duolingo and our employees will never ask for your Social Security number, bank details, or passport info, and we’ll never ask you to deposit a check, purchase equipment, or exchange money during the interview process. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double-check these details before sharing any information.
