At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor​y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Title: Systems Engineer

Location : Royersford, PA (On-site)

Evening Shift : 4 PM to 12:30 AM EST

Travel : Willing to travel domestically up to 15% of the time.

Eligibility Requirements: Must be a US citizen and eligible to obtain a Public Trust clearance.

Job Summary

This role requires an experienced IT professional with a proven record of accomplishment to support this fast-paced and high-volume environment. Reporting to the IT Manager for Global DS Service Operations, you will be the on-site lead for the Service Operations team at our Royersford imaging center.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:

Provide Critical Site Support: Deliver on-site support at our Royersford imaging center and provide support for our central imaging and file transfer environments (FISMA/IMGS).

Manage Infrastructure: Take day-to-day operational ownership of critical hardware and software, including high-speed scanners, imaging tools, and file transfer (delivery) management.

Drive Maintenance & SLA Adherence: Lead daily maintenance activities to ensure smooth IT operations while keeping systems continuously available to meet project SLAs.

Handle Escalations & On-Call: Manage the proper daily escalation of technical issues and participate in off-hour on-call support.

Onboard Customers: Successfully onboard new Digital Solutions (DS) customers and process change requests for existing accounts.

Optimize Processes: Work to improve existing standard processes and develop comprehensive controls to monitor productivity, quality, and SLA adherence using industry-proven best practices.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Meet with Implementation and DevOps teams to roll out platform fixes and functional enhancements.

What You’ll Bring

The ideal candidate will have:

Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) from a four-year college or university OR over 5 years of dedicated IT industry work experience.

Technical System Expertise: Extensive experience with remote control tools, Windows 10, Windows 11, Windows Server 2016, SQL Database, and Active Directory.

Specialized Software Skills: Direct experience deploying and troubleshooting Kofax (imaging software) and performing Batch class deployments.

IT Infrastructure Knowledge: Deep understanding of the various IT functions (Desktop, Server, Network), with providing on-site technical support and hardware/software installation.

Network & Scripting Skills : Foundational network management and support knowledge (switches, routers, and firewalls) along with desired PowerShell scripting experience.

Project & Strategic Ability : Experience in program/project management with the ability to plan strategically, hit numerous deadlines, and pivot quickly in an environment with changing priorities.

Communication & Collaboration : Excellent verbal and written communication skills tailored for a wide range of audiences, including executives, business stakeholders, and IT teams. Demonstrated ability to work independently or collaborate via cross-functional initiatives.

Mobility: Willingness and capability to handle limited travel up to 15%.

What We Offer

Day-One Benefits: Enjoy comprehensive health, wellness, and retirement plans with robust benefits starting on your first day of employment.

Empowering Your Balance: Flexible vacation plan to support your personal and professional well-being.

Continuous Career Development: Elevate your skills through ongoing training, corporate learning resources, and internal advancement opportunities on a global scale.

Compensation & Care: Competitive salary commensurate with your experience, paired with a comprehensive company-wide benefits package.

Category: Information Technology

Iron Mountain is a global leader in storage and information management services trusted by more than 225,000 organizations in 60 countries. We safeguard billions of our customers’ assets, including critical business information, highly sensitive data, and invaluable cultural and historic artifacts. Take a look at our history here .

Iron Mountain helps lower cost and risk, comply with regulations, recover from disaster, and enable digital and sustainable solutions, whether in information management, digital transformation, secure storage and destruction, data center operations, cloud services, or art storage and logistics. Please see our Values and Code of Ethics for a look at our principles and aspirations in elevating the power of our work together.

jobs.description:
About the Role:
As a CBRE MDM Sr Principal Engineer, you will be at the forefront of transforming CBRE's enterprise data landscape, with Master Data Management central to this initiative. You will take ownership of our Reltio MDM platform, serving as the ultimate subject matter expert for all Reltio-related aspects. You will architect data models, design complex match/merge rules, and drive the technical vision for MDM across the entire enterprise. This high-impact individual contributor role, reporting directly to the Senior Director of Data Governance and Engineering, requires you to bridge the gap between business strategy and technical execution, ensuring our master data is accurate, connected, and scalable. You will be embedded within a 20-person governance and engineering team, playing a crucial role in our data evolution.
This job is part of the Software Engineering job function. They are responsible for successfully executing and monitoring system improvements to increase efficiency.
What You’ll Do:
Architect and build enterprise-grade Master Data Management solutions natively within Reltio, owning the platform end-to-end.Design and configure complex L3 configurations, match/merge rules, survivorship frameworks, and data quality workflows.Define and maintain the MDM data model across CBRE’s core entity domains — clients, properties, counterparties, and organizations — ensuring models are scalable as new domains onboard.Establish and govern MDM engineering standards for configuration, naming conventions, API usage, and environment management (dev/test/prod).Lead technical integrations between Reltio, Snowflake, AWS, and upstream/downstream systems using SnapLogic and direct API patterns.Build and maintain data synchronization pipelines that keep master data consistent across the CBRE data estate — from source systems through to Snowflake and governed data products.Partner with the Collibra Engineering Lead to ensure Reltio entity data is accurately reflected in the data catalog, lineage, and governance metadata.Partner with the DQ Engineering Lead to ensure MDM entity resolution and survivorship outputs are monitored and quality-scored within SODA.Collaborate with the Principal AI Engineer to integrate LLM-based entity matching, deduplication, and enrichment capabilities into Reltio workflows.Evaluate and implement AI-assisted MDM capabilities — intelligent match scoring, automated survivorship decisions, and anomaly flagging — to reduce manual stewardship burden at scale.Ensure AI-generated MDM outputs are governed, auditable, and validated against CBRE’s data quality and governance standards before promotion to master.Set the standard for MDM best practices, data modeling, and governance standards across the team.Build UI/UX experiences for data stewards — workflows, dashboards, and issue queues in Reltio that make stewardship intuitive and efficient.Act as the senior technical voice on MDM in cross-functional forums — architecture reviews, data product launches, and governance councils.Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Navigate objections and disagreements. Set the tone for teams to reach an agreement and adopt a different point of view. Negotiate with senior and executive management, customers, regulators, or vendors to influence decisions of visionary and strategic importance.Apply ingenuity and creativity to problem analysis and resolution in complicated and/or novel situations.
What You’ll Need:
To perform this job successfully, an individual will need to perform each crucial duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
Bachelor's Degree preferred with 10+ years of relevant experience in Master Data Management (MDM) implementation at an enterprise scale. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. Deep expertise in Reltio MDM solutions, including extensive hands-on experience with L3 configuration, Reltio API, and UI configuration.Mastery of MDM concepts, entity resolution, graph databases, and data governance frameworks.Proficiency with modern data stacks (e.g., Snowflake, AWS) and integration platforms (e.g., SnapLogic, REST APIs).Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into scalable Reltio data models and survivorship workflows.Strong leadership and communication skills, capable of driving technical projects from concept to production and explaining complex MDM concepts to diverse stakeholders.Independent judgment skills to determine methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for measuring success.Ability to recognize and resolve situations of substantial significance in a field of expertise or knowledge. In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc. Must be meticulously organized and have a masterful inquisitive mindset.
Why CBRE:
When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.
Our Values in Hiring:
At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.
Disclaimer:
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
Applicant AI Use Disclosure:
We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.
About CBRE Group, Inc.
CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2024 revenue). The company has more than 140,000 employees (including Turner & Townsend employees) serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage serving, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). Please visit our website at www.cbre.com.

In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025 , a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

The Endpoint Engineer – AI Desktop Deployment is responsible for designing, deploying, securing, and maintaining enterprise Windows endpoints that support AI-enabled desktop capabilities in highly regulated, government, and Zero Trust environments. This role combines traditional Windows desktop engineering with modern endpoint management, security compliance, application deployment, performance optimization, and device health monitoring.

The engineer will work closely with cybersecurity, cloud, identity, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure endpoints are secure, compliant, performant, and ready to support AI-enabled applications and workloads. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Endpoint Manager, Windows 10/11, Group Policy, application packaging, and Zero Trust endpoint controls.

Job Responsibilities

- Perform enterprise desktop engineering for Windows 10 and Windows 11, including operating system configuration, deployment, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting.

- Administer and engineer Microsoft Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager environments for device enrollment, configuration, application deployment, compliance, and endpoint security.

- Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot Group Policy Objects (GPOs) supporting enterprise security, configuration, and operational requirements.

- Establish and maintain standardized Windows endpoint configurations, deployment methodologies, and engineering documentation.

- Develop and maintain Windows provisioning and deployment solutions, including Autopilot and automated device enrollment where applicable.

- Evaluate Windows updates, feature releases, drivers, firmware, and endpoint configuration changes before production deployment.

- Support endpoint modernization efforts and migration from legacy endpoint-management technologies to cloud-managed or hybrid-management architectures.

- Automate repetitive endpoint administration and configuration tasks using PowerShell and other approved scripting technologies.

Job Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.

- Experience deploying Microsoft Copilot, AI assistants, or other enterprise AI desktop applications.

- Familiarity with enterprise AI governance, data-loss prevention, information protection, and access-control considerations for generative AI tools.

- Experience evaluating endpoint hardware and software readiness for AI-enabled workloads.

- Familiarity with Windows AI capabilities, AI-enabled productivity platforms, or locally executed AI workloads.

- Experience integrating endpoint-management telemetry with security, identity, IT operations, or SIEM platforms.

- Experience with Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Graph, PowerShell automation, or proactive remediation technologies.

Government Cloud & Zero Trust Responsibilities

- Implement and maintain device compliance and Conditional Access controls supporting the Zero Trust device pillar.

- Engineer, deploy, and maintain STIG-compliant endpoint security baselines for Windows systems.

- Apply and maintain DISA STIG, organizational security baseline, and applicable federal endpoint-hardening requirements.

- Configure Intune compliance policies, configuration profiles, endpoint security policies, and security baselines for government environments.

- Support endpoint-management capabilities within applicable Microsoft Government Cloud environments, including GCC, GCC High, or related environments as required.

- Integrate endpoint posture and device-compliance signals with identity and access-control solutions.

- Ensure only authorized, managed, compliant, and appropriately secured devices can access protected enterprise resources.

- Implement endpoint controls supporting Zero Trust principles including device identity, continuous verification, least privilege, and risk-based access.

- Coordinate with identity teams on Microsoft Entra ID device registration, join models, Conditional Access, and authentication requirements.

- Support Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent endpoint detection, security telemetry, vulnerability-management, and response capabilities.

- Remediate endpoint vulnerabilities, configuration findings, compliance exceptions, and security control deficiencies.

- Assist with evidence collection and technical documentation supporting security assessments, audits, authorization activities, and continuous monitoring.

- Support endpoint configurations aligned with applicable NIST, FISMA, FedRAMP, CISA, DoD, or agency-specific security requirements, as applicable to the environment.

Preferred Certifications:

- Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) — strongly desired.

- AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner — desired only if the position supports or integrates with AWS environments.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a role where you're critical to every part of the business? Do you want to help ensure that our teams deliver software so that our analysts can deliver service to our customers? How about being a crucial part of making sure our internal teams operate efficiently?

You're not afraid of new technology. In fact, you love diving in and figuring out how it works. Whether it's a successful launch or a few bumps in the road, you're always up for a challenge. Balancing multiple projects at once is no easy feat, but when everything clicks into place, there's nothing quite like that sense of satisfaction.

The best part of the job? Seeing someone use a capability you've built and hearing them exclaim, "Wow, I can't believe how easy that was." You care about the success of your colleagues and take pride in helping them achieve it.

As a cloud-based IT organization, we're breaking the traditional mold and thinking creatively about how we can make the day-to-day life of our employees simple. We're always looking for innovative solutions, and we need someone with the wit and determination to help us achieve our goals.

In this role, you'll keep Expel's IT infrastructure and services secure and highly available, from our cloud platforms all the way down to the equipment in our conference rooms. You'll manage access across the employee lifecycle, own large cross-functional projects from beginning to end, and take manual work out of how we operate before anyone feels the friction. It's based onsite at our Herndon, Virginia headquarters, so you'll also be the person who makes sure the technology people walk up and touch works exactly like it should.

If you're up for the challenge, we want to hear from you!

* * *

### **What Expel Can Do For You**

- Provide the autonomy to define problems and propose solutions.
- Deliver never-ending opportunities to tackle business problems.
- Give you real ownership of large cross-functional projects, end to end.
- Surround you with a team of problem solvers.
- Ensure you get support, mentoring, and feedback to make you successful.

* * *

### **What You Can Do For Expel**

- Manage and maintain IT systems in a cloud first environment.
- Provide friendly and unflappable technical support.
- Make sure new hires have the accounts, access, and hardware they need on day one, and that access goes away promptly when people leave.
- Be the point of contact for the systems and services you own.
- Own large cross-functional projects from beginning to end.
- Collaborate with multi-functional teams to identify integration issues, solve errors, and optimize performance.
- Proactively find opportunities for improvement and build automations that streamline operations and reduce manual work.
- Apply AI tooling, like Claude and Gemini, to accelerate day-to-day work.
- Manage IT-owned technology at Expel's HQ, including network equipment, conference room and AV equipment, kiosk computers, and other shared-space systems.
- Keep people in the loop on service disruptions and changes.
- Work alongside our security team to protect our information.
- Contribute to the team's roadmap and work in two week sprints against quarterly and yearly goals.
- Build and routinely update documentation on automations, configurations, and operating procedures.

* * *

### **What You Should Bring With You**

- Proficiency managing core enterprise SaaS products such as Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft 365.
- Experience automating tasks and integrating systems using platforms like Workato, Okta Workflows, or Microsoft Power Automate.
- Experience with AI platforms like Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, including prompt engineering and connecting systems through emerging standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Knowledge of concepts like SAML, OIDC, SCIM, REST APIs, webhooks, JWT, and OAuth 2.0.
- Knowledge of programming and scripting languages like Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Ruby.
- macOS and Windows operating system administration skills, including experience with MDMs like Jamf and Intune.
- Familiarity with conference room AV and shared-space technology, like Zoom Rooms and Neat devices.
- Knowledge of Cisco Meraki and basic networking concepts like VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and wireless networking.
- Strong project management skills, especially on large cross-functional projects.
- Capacity to balance a mix of urgent, interrupt-driven tasks and project-level work.
- Excellent customer service and communication skills, written and verbal, with a habit of treating colleagues like customers.
- Adept at translating technical concepts and communicating to non-technical audiences.
- Outstanding problem solving abilities, with a desire to get to the root of sophisticated issues.
- Well-versed in IT operations best practices.
- 5+ years of professional experience with IT, 2+ of which were in an engineering or sysadmin capacity.
- A college degree or credible panache.

* * *

### **Additional Notes**

This is an onsite, in-person role working out of our headquarters in Herndon, Virginia. Individuals must be located within the Washington D.C. metropolitan area.

The base salary range for this role is between $93,900 USD and $136,200 USD + bonus eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $105,000 and $125,000 based on experience, skills, and market data.

You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We’re only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

jobs.description:
An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

Position Summary

The Senior Platforms Engineer is responsible for the strategic design, deployment, and optimization of complex infrastructure platforms and systems, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security. This qualified candidate will have proven experience as a technical lead or platform owner for digital workplace or AI initiatives.

This role will maintain ownership throughout the entire lifecycle of AI agents and automation, handling intake, governance, versioning, monitoring, and retirement in production environments. An expected focus of this role is to deliver impactful AI value and usage reports, presenting productivity improvements, risk assessments, and cost optimization metrics to leadership and business stakeholders.

This role leads advanced troubleshooting, performance tuning, and technical support activities, serving as the primary escalation point for complex issues and collaborating across teams to drive continuous improvement. The Senior Platforms Engineer also oversees resiliency, disaster recovery and backup strategies, develops comprehensive reporting frameworks, and ensures compliance with industry standards and best practices.

The candidate will have designed and implemented secure, enterprise-grade low-code applications for regulated and sensitive data, ensuring compliance and robust protection measures.

Additionally, this position fosters a culture of knowledge sharing by mentoring junior engineers, organizing training sessions, and promoting cross-functional collaboration to enhance documentation and information sharing.

This position belongs to a family of jobs with increasing responsibility, competency, and skill level. Actual position title and pay grade will be based on the selected candidate’s experience and qualifications.

Key Responsibilities

Identifies performance bottlenecks, conducts root cause analysis, and proposes and implements solutions to enhance platform & system performance and resource utilization. Establishes performance benchmarks, conducts capacity planning, and collaborates with other teams, including junior engineers and cross functional teams to optimize infrastructure performance and activities.
Contributes to the development and improvement of troubleshooting procedures, measures to minimize platform & system downtime, and documentation. Partners with technical support to drive for resolution. Leads and manages platform & system technical support activities and troubleshooting efforts, including handling escalated and complex issues. Performs advanced system tuning and optimization to maximize performance using IT Service Management practices. Collaborates with Systems and Solution Architects, Governance, Regulatory and Compliance as well as other organizational teams to enhance support processes and methodologies.
Participates in future platform & system backup planning. Leads the design of disaster/system recovery and testing.
Analyzes Power Platform, Copilot Studio, AI agent, and digital workplace platform performance and utilization data to identify trends and patterns. Provides recommendations for optimization, cost efficiency, reliability, and value realization. Prepares executive‑ready reporting and drives corrective actions to continuously improve platform and AI service outcomes.
Leads development of advanced troubleshooting procedures and operational runbooks for Power Platform solutions, AI agents, and automations. Serves as the primary escalation point for complex platform, automation, or agent issues. Coordinates with vendors and internal teams to resolve incidents and continuously improve service reliability and operational maturity.
Leads the creation and maintenance of a comprehensive knowledge base for platforms & systems, including troubleshooting guides, configuration documentation, and best practices. Promotes knowledge sharing culture by organizing training sessions, mentoring junior engineers, and encouraging cross-team collaboration.

Education and Experience

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, related field or equivalent experience required
Five (5) or more years of relevant experience required.

Administered and supported Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Agents, Azure Services) in enterprise environments highly preferred.
Experience applying automation design patterns, managed error handling, monitoring, and provided operational support for platforms highly preferred.
Developed and delivered platform usage, reliability, and adoption reporting for leadership and stakeholders preferred.
Implemented environment strategies, solution packaging, and application lifecycle management practices for low-code platforms preferred.
Managed security, identity, and access controls within Microsoft 365 and Power Platform preferred.

Skills

Cloud Infrastructure Management - Setting up, configuring, monitoring, and optimizing the components of cloud infrastructure.
Computer Networking - A system in which multiple computers are connected to each other to share information and resources.
Cybersecurity Risk Management - The process of developing cyber risk assessment and treatment techniques that can effectively pre-empt and identify significant security loopholes and weaknesses, demonstrating the business risks associated with these loopholes and providing risk treatment and prioritization strategies to effectively address the cyber-related risks, threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring appropriate levels of protection, confidentiality, integrity and privacy in alignment with the security framework.
DevSecOps - A set of practices that automates the integration of security at every phase of the software development lifecycle, from initial design through integration, testing, deployment, and software delivery, with an aim towards shortening the systems development life cycle and pas well as continuous delivery and a security first approach.
General Programming - Applies a computer language to communicate with computers using a set of instructions and to automate the execution of tasks.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) - The process of managing and provisioning infrastructure through code instead of through manual processes.
IT Infrastructure Management - Planning, design, delivery and control of information technology infrastructure.
Performance Monitoring - The process of measuring the performance of a system in real time in order to determine problems and identify other factors that may cause problems in the future.
Policy Management - The process of creating, implementing and maintaining policies and procedures within an organization.
Process Automation - Also known as business automation or digital transformation, this is the technology-enabled automation of complex business processes. It can streamline a business for simplicity, achieve digital transformation, increase service quality, improve service delivery or contain costs. It consists of integrating applications, restructuring labor resources and using software applications throughout the organization.
Service Delivery Management - The manner in which an organization provides users access to IT services, which include applications, data storage and other business resources.
Systems Administration - Performs a variety of functions including user management, system monitoring, system configuration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and access control.
System Platform- A system platform refers to the underlying foundation or framework that supports and manages the operation of software applications and hardware components within a computing environment. It provides a standardized and cohesive infrastructure, allowing for the development, deployment, and integration of various technologies and services.
Systems Testing - The process of testing conducted on a complete integrated system to evaluate the system's compliance with its specified requirements.
Systems Integration - The process of linking together various IT systems, services and/or software to enable all of them to work functionally together.
Troubleshooting - The act or process of discovering and resolving problems, disputes, or mechanical issues through a systematic, usually iterative, approach.
AI Platform Reliability & Incident Management – Operating AI agents and automation platforms in production, including incident response, root cause analysis, and post‑incident remediation.
Enterprise ALM & Release Management – Managing solution promotion, version control, and coordinated releases for low‑code and AI solutions across environments.
Data Integration & Connector Strategy – Integrating Power Platform and AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, and data sources while managing connector risk and performance.
Identity, Access & Permissions Modeling – Designing and enforcing role‑based access, service accounts, managed identities, and secure permission models.
Cost Awareness & Optimization (FinOps) – Monitoring usage patterns and identifying optimization opportunities for AI, automation, and platform services.
Platform Standardization & Pattern Development – Defining reusable patterns, reference architectures, and templates for AI agents, workflows, and low‑code applications.
Change Management & Adoption Enablement – Supporting rollout, operational readiness, and adoption of AI‑enabled digital workplace capabilities.
Vendor & Third‑Party Platform Coordination – Partnering with vendors to resolve issues, influence roadmaps, and evaluate emerging capabilities.
Risk Assessment & Compliance Alignment – Assessing AI and platform solutions against security, privacy, regulatory, and audit requirements.
Technical Communication & Executive Readouts – Translating platform and AI operational data into clear, decision‑ready insights for leadership.

Collins Aerospace, an RTX company, is looking for a Principal Systems Engineer with a passion for engineering and desire to join the Athena Control Systems Team. As a Principal Systems Engineer on the Athena Control Systems Team, you will be leading the development, certification, and maintenance of systems for safety-critical commercial and military applications. In this role, you'll work with a team of highly motivated world class engineers, ensuring our solutions meet the highest standards of quality and safety.

You will be asked to apply your knowledge in the following areas to a variety of products/applications that are relevant to both military and commercial industries:

• System dynamics and state estimation (linear/nonlinear, navigation/PNT, cooperative PNT, distributed PNT, inertial sensor modeling, oscillator modeling)
• Guidance (path planning, mission planning, cooperative teaming, tactical maneuvering)
• Control (Fixed Wing, VTOL, HVTOL, Rotorcraft)
• Perception (Classification, Identification, SLAM, Feature tracking, Automatic Target Recognition)

• Lead and participate in software design and program reviews to ensure team progress against milestones are met and tracking project schedules

• Lead and manage the engineering bid and planning process for a multi-disciplinary engineering team
• Work on multiple programs simultaneously
• Provide communication and status to relevant stakeholders
• Support verification and traceability of the system requirements
• Support peer reviews on test procedures & design documentation
• Help drive resolution for technical issues through problem-solving and coordination across impacted teams and subject matter experts
• Opportunity to help improve our development processes and tools
• This position will require up to 15% travel

• Strong working knowledge of C/C++, embedded and application software development background, using Matlab and real time operating systems
• Experience with developing certified safety critical systems
• Experience with system integration testing on hardware in a lab environment
• Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years of experience

Qualifications We Prefer
• Experience evaluating inertial, air data and magnetometer sensors
• Working knowledge of the Systems Engineering Discipline
• Working knowledge and experience with GNSS, DGNSS, RTK and WAAS
• Experience working with Requirements Based Development and Requirements Management Tools
• Experience with embedded communications protocols, antennas and Flight Dynamics for Rotary and Fixed Wing Platforms
• Experience troubleshooting and finding solutions for test equipment and automated test failures
• Experience in developing system level solutions that integrate multiple systems into a single offering
• Have knowledge and experience with the aerospace industry, sensor fusion, vehicle control, computer vision, and algorithm development

**Workload: 100%** Join us in Madrid to shape the future of modern workplace solutions! We are a forward-thinking organization dedicated to empowering businesses through innovative technology. If you're passionate about Microsoft 365 and device management, we want to hear from you.

* Manage and maintain Microsoft Intune for provisioning, configuration, and compliance across devices (Windows, macOS, iOS, Android).

* Configure and enforce security policies for endpoint devices, ensuring updates, patching, and antivirus compliance.
* Monitor device performance and ensure adherence to organizational policies using Intune and M365 tools.
* Collaborate with IT and business teams to design and deploy modern workplace solutions.
* Provide technical support for M365 services, focusing on hardware and software integration.

**What you bring \& who you are:**

* Proven experience managing Microsoft 365 services, including Intune.
* Hands-on expertise in device provisioning and lifecycle management.
* Strong knowledge of endpoint security, compliance, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with Azure Active Directory and device identity management.
* Excellent problem-solving and communication skills to support and train users.

**Ideally, you also bring:**

* Certifications in Microsoft 365 (e.g., Modern Desktop Administrator Associate, Enterprise Administrator Expert).
* PowerShell scripting knowledge for automation and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with hardware procurement and vendor management.
* Basic networking knowledge and troubleshooting skills.
* Spanish skills are a plus

* Training courses Our company is committed to helping our employees grow and develop their skills, which is why we offer a variety of industry- specific training courses and a learning channel.

jobs.description:
We are looking for an IT Architect Endpoint Management profile to join our IT team.

We are looking for an IT Architect Endpoint Management profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you’ll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you’ll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented in accordance with BSI-CON-11.1. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

Due to the international scope of the role, working hours are not fixed and may include evening, night, weekend, or rotating shifts, depending on the regions being supported.

Key responsibilities

- Developing and designing a highly secure endpoint management environment with clear target architectures and standards

- Leading endpoint management projects from planning through design to implementation, as well as actively participating in project teamwork

- Ensuring that security, compliance, and regulatory requirements (e.g., in accordance with guidelines from the Federal Office for Information Security, including BSI-CON-11.1) are met in the endpoint architectures

- Managing external service providers and coordinating the interfaces between IT security, infrastructure, and operations

- Evaluating and implementing new solutions and technologies in the endpoint environment to continuously improve the IT workstations

- Degree in computer science, business informatics, or a comparable qualification in the IT field

- At least 5 years of professional experience in endpoint management (operations and/or architecture) in medium-sized or large IT environments

- Good knowledge of common endpoint management tools, ideally such as Microsoft Intune and Tanium

- In-depth understanding of IT security, compliance, and regulatory requirements, preferably in regulated environments and in accordance with BSI guidelines

- A structured, independent work style, as well as strong communication and collaboration skills

- Willingness to undergo a security clearance screening in accordance with the Security Clearance Act (SÜG)

- A high level of English is required (C1)

- To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working

- We promote your professional and personal development through individually tailored student mentoring

- Make valuable contacts within Drees & Sommer and expand your professional network

- Modern workplace and equipment; Teams meetings and participation in corporate workshops

- Receive compensation that gives you financial independence during your studies

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let’s create a world we want to live in.

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Service Credit Union is seeking an on-site Desktop Engineer (Microsoft) with highly skilled technical expert and significant in-depth, hands-on experience designing, deploying and maintaining desktop computing environments to ensure optimal functionality, security, and user satisfaction. This role involves configuring and troubleshooting end-user devices, including desktops. Laptops, and tablets, and implementing secure and efficient desktop solutions. Working closely with IT support teams and system administrators, the Desktop Engineer ensures that devices are configured to company standards, secure from vulnerabilities, and optimized for performance, while providing technical support to improve the overall end-user experience. Successful applicants should be able to work with application business owners, Service Desk, IT Applications team, and Information Security departments to deliver a streamlined and secure user desktop experience.

“Members are the priority at Service Credit Union, and every role at the credit union is responsible for supporting member solutions and contributing positively to member experience.”

Compensation range: $86,063 - $103,829/yearly, depending on experience and qualifications. Junior level candidates typically start at the lower end of the range, with opportunities for growth as skills develop.

Location: This is an on-site position following our hybrid requirements of three days on-site and two days remote. Candidates must live within 60 miles of our corporate office located at 3003 Lafayette Road, Portsmouth NH.

Benefits Include:

Great health and dental benefits starting day one!PTO, long-term disability, and paid holidays. 401k with 8% company contribution after one year of employment. Paid leave policy after 12 consecutive months of employment. Free confidential mental health support program with TalkspaceFree identify theft protection through IdentityForceTuition reimbursement. Training and career growth opportunities.

Position Responsibilities:

Manage, configure, and maintain Windows and/or Mac operating systems, including imaging, patching, and software deployment for the organization in accordance with SFCU’s security and best practices guidelines. Develop and maintain Windows images in the physical desktop environment. Establish standards in desktop hardware and develop and maintain scripts to automate repetitive tasks and improve efficiency. Ensure all SFCU approved peripheral devices are compatible and have full functionality with standardized physical hardware. Thoroughly test any new peripheral devices to ensure full functionality with selected standardized hardware. Ensure desktop environments remain patched and up to date with latest approved security patches. Work with Application team on client/server application upgrades at the desktop level and update images accordingly. Works with the Service Desk for desktop related information sharing and support and act as 2nd/3rd -tier support for escalated hardware, software, and connectivity issues. Produce and maintain desktop standards, knowledge base, operating procedures, guidelines and system documentation. Works with appropriate third-party vendors as necessaryParticipate in weekly on call rotation. Adhere to organization and department standards and processes such as Change Management, Information Security, and Data Governance. Maintain confidentiality regarding credit union policies and procedures, financial data, personal information, and work-related events. Provide quality support and maintain a professional relationship with peers, management, other staff, and members through cooperation, mutual trust and respect. Regular and reliable attendance is an essential function of this position. Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Knowledge and Skills:

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering or a related technical discipline, or the equivalent combination of education and/or technical training. 3 - 5 years' experience in a desktop engineering and/or a desktop support role. Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate. Experience developing, optimizing, and hardening desktop OS master images. Strong experience with Microsoft Intune, SCCM, Active Directory, Azure AD, and endpoint management tools. Excellent task management, organizational, and communication skills. Experience with various physical desktop hardware. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and to meet deadlines. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Proven crisis management skills. Interpersonal skills necessary to work effectively with cross functional teams and staff.

Service Credit Union and its employees are required by federal regulations to comply with anti-money laundering laws and initiatives, including the Bank Secrecy Act and regulations promulgated by the Office of Foreign Assets Control. As a condition of employment, all employees must certify that they have received the training provided by Service Credit Union and understand that they are required to comply as a condition of employment with these regulations.

Job Title

Systems Engineer - IT Salesforce Platform

Position Overview

Shaw Industries Group, Inc. is a leader in flooring and other surface solutions designed for residential housing, commercial spaces and outdoor environments. Leveraging strengths in design, innovation and operational excellence, the company takes a people-centered, customer-focused, and growth-minded approach to meet diverse market needs. It creates differentiated customer experiences through its expansive portfolio of brands: Anderson Tuftex, COREtec, Shaw Floors, Patcraft, Philadelphia Commercial, Shaw Contract, Shaw Sports Turf, Shawgrass, Southwest Greens, Watershed Geo and more. Headquartered in Dalton, Georgia, Shaw is a wholly owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway, Inc. with more than $6 billion in annual sales and 18,000 associates worldwide.

Position Overview

Our mission is to design, engineer, and continuously evolve enterprise-grade system solutions that enable Shaw to remain a market leader. As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will play a critical role in architecting and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions on the Salesforce platform (SFDC), the world's leading Customer Relationship Management system.

This role goes beyond development to include solution architecture, technical leadership, and strategic alignment with business objectives. You will partner closely with Commercial Sales, Product Owners, Enterprise Architecture, and cross-functional technology teams to design future-state capabilities across Desktop and Mobile platforms.

This position offers a dynamic opportunity to lead complex initiatives, influence platform strategy, and mentor engineering talent while driving innovation within a cloud-first ecosystem.

jobs.description:
**Company Description** Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let's create a world we want to live in.

**Job Description** We are looking for an**IT Architect Endpoint Management** profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you'll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you'll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented in accordance with BSI-CON-11.1. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

Due to the international scope of the role, working hours are not fixed and may include**evening, night, weekend, or rotating shifts,** depending on the regions being supported.

**Key Responsibilities** **Endpoint Architecture \& Strategy**

* Develop and design a highly secure endpoint management environment with clear target architectures, standards, and governance models.
* Ensure that security, compliance, and regulatory requirements (e.g., BSI-CON-11.1 and related guidelines) are embedded into endpoint architectures and operational processes.
* Evaluate, design, and implement new endpoint technologies and solutions to continuously improve the digital workplace experience.
* Lead endpoint management projects from planning and design through implementation and operational transition.

**Endpoint Operations \& Management**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for complex endpoint-related incidents, service requests, and problem management activities.
* Manage incidents through their full lifecycle, perform root cause analysis, and drive permanent resolution of recurring issues.
* Support and maintain Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 endpoint management services.
* Configure, test, and optimize device policies, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and endpoint security controls.
* Monitor endpoint compliance, coordinate remediation activities, and support device lifecycle management processes.
* Support onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning, and deployment activities for end users.

**Software Deployment \& Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee software packaging, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management activities for business applications and endpoint platforms.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application deployment and device management issues.
* Validate new endpoint configurations, policies, and solutions before production rollout.
* Participate in pilot deployments, testing initiatives, automation efforts, and continuous service improvement programs.

**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**

* Manage external service providers and coordinate interfaces between IT Security, Infrastructure, Workplace Services, and Operations teams.
* Act as a technical advisor and escalation point for endpoint-related topics across the organization.
* Support knowledge sharing and technical enablement within the Endpoint Management team.

**Documentation \& Governance**

* Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture standards, operational procedures, and knowledge base articles.
* Document recurring issues, standard solutions, and architectural decisions.
* Ensure endpoint management processes and documentation align with security and compliance requirements.

**Qualifications**

* 4 years of experience in Endpoint Management, IT Operations, or advanced IT Support
* Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management solutions
* Knowledge of software packaging and application deployment
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Understanding of endpoint security and compliance concepts
* Basic PowerShell knowledge is an advantage
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* A high level of English is required (C1)

**Additional Information**

* To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
* We promote your professional and personal development through individually tailored student mentoring
* Make valuable contacts within Drees \& Sommer and expand your professional network
* Modern workplace and equipment; Teams meetings and participation in corporate workshops
* Receive compensation that gives you financial independence during your studies

jobs.description:
#### **The Basics:**

Tanium's Product Management team is actively seeking a **Director, Product Management** to lead **Policy and Configuration Management for the Endpoint Management portfolio**. This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for owning the strategy, roadmap, and execution of how Tanium defines, applies, and proves configuration state across the enterprise — giving IT and Security teams a single way to set policy once and enforce it consistently across Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoints, regardless of whether those endpoints are on-premises, remote, or in the cloud.

The successful candidate will own the product strategy behind Tanium's centralized policy engine: application allow/deny control, full-disk encryption, device and removable media control, host firewall management, and machine- and user-scoped administrative template (Group Policy-style) policy. This includes the migration tooling that lets customers import existing Group Policy backups and industry hardening standards — such as CIS Build Kits and vendor security baselines — directly into managed policy. You will also shape the next generation of policy types that supersede legacy mechanisms as customers modernize off traditional, on-premises group policy infrastructure.

You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to set vision, drive roadmap, ship capabilities customers trust for compliance and audit, and turn consistent configuration state into measurable risk reduction for customers.

A successful candidate is a strong communicator and influencer who can operate fluently across executive stakeholder conversations, deep technical architecture discussions, and customer-facing storytelling. Must have a successful track record of shipping enterprise configuration management, compliance, or policy products at scale.

#### What you'll do

- Own the **product strategy, roadmap, and delivery** for Tanium's endpoint policy and configuration management capabilities, end to end from ideation to launch.
- Drive the roadmap for **Windows policy and configuration management** — application control (allow/deny rules), full-disk encryption, device and removable storage control, host firewall management, and machine- and user-scoped administrative template policy — ensuring parity with and differentiation from traditional Group Policy infrastructure.
- Expand **Linux configuration management** capabilities (e.g., host firewall management and hardening controls), building out coverage on top of an established Windows foundation.
- Own the strategy for **legacy migration and baseline import tooling** — Group Policy backup import and industry hardening standard support (CIS Build Kits, vendor security baselines) that automatically convert a downloaded benchmark file into a ready-to-enforce compliance policy, complete with conflict detection across overlapping settings and automatic content-set mapping — and for next-generation policy types that supersede legacy equivalents as customers modernize.
- Define and evolve **policy enforcement state and compliance reporting** (applied, partially applied, superseded, not applied) so customers can prove configuration compliance and audit posture at any time.
- Partner with incident response, reporting, and guidance capabilities across the platform to turn security findings into durable preventive policy and to surface actionable configuration drift and remediation guidance to operators.
- Document customer use cases, product requirements, and business justifications for new policy and configuration investments; prioritize ruthlessly based on customer risk reduction, compliance mandates, and platform leverage.
- Partner with Product Marketing and Sales to develop **go-to-market motions, enablement, and messaging**; support launches, analyst engagements, and customer briefings.
- Cultivate **strategic customer relationships** to validate direction, surface gaps, and turn lighthouse deployments into reference architectures.
- Establish and track KPIs — policy adoption, time-to-compliance, configuration drift and remediation rates, and platform pull-through — and use them to drive continuous improvement.
- Leverage emerging trends in **agentic AI and autonomous IT** to shape the roadmap for self-healing, continuously enforced endpoint configuration.

#### Requirements

#### Education

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
- Masters in Computer Science or MBA preferred.

#### Experience

- **8+ years** of total professional experience in enterprise B2B software, with at least **5 years in product management** supporting a SaaS or enterprise platform.
- **Required:** hands-on experience with **Windows policy and configuration management** — Group Policy, ADMX administrative templates, security baselines, full-disk encryption, application control, or comparable endpoint configuration tooling.
- **Strong bonus:** in-depth experience with **Linux configuration management** — configuration/hardening frameworks, host firewall management, or compliance baselines for Linux systems.
- Demonstrated success **owning and shipping policy, compliance, or configuration management products** at enterprise scale.
- Deep familiarity with **endpoint management and IT operations** — including the customer workflows that span IT and Security teams.
- Strong fluency with **compliance frameworks and industry baselines** (e.g., CIS benchmarks, vendor security baselines) and how they translate into enforceable policy.
- Experience working with **executive stakeholders** to align on vision, secure investment, and unblock execution.
- Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, marketing, and sales without direct authority.

#### Other

- Align with the Tanium values: **we win as a team, we do the right thing, and we are unstoppable**.
- Intuition to identify high-leverage configuration and compliance gaps that align with Tanium's platform and present opportunities for rapid growth.
- Willingness to take on firmly-entrenched, legacy configuration management incumbents with creative approaches to technology and a tenacious pursuit to build and grow a product's customer base.
- Ability to establish and nurture strong customer champions who can serve as advocates and an informal advisory board.
- Strong written communication, verbal communication, and executive presentation skills.
- Adept at understanding and navigating complex organizations in order to inspire and influence internal and external stakeholders.
- Grit; ability to deal with and overcome challenges, and to thrive in ambiguity.

**About Tanium**

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. Driven by AI and real-time endpoint intelligence, Tanium Autonomous IT empowers IT and security teams to make their organizations unstoppable.

Many of the world’s leading organizations trust Tanium’s single, unified platform for endpoint management and security to innovate faster, stay resilient and move business forward with confidence, at scale. To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business – visit [www.tanium.com](http://www.tanium.com/) and follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/tanium) and [X](https://twitter.com/Tanium).

**On a mission. Together.**

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.

**What you’ll get**

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $214,000 to $328,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience.

In addition to an annual base salary, team members will receive equity awards and a generous benefits package consisting of medical, dental and vision plan, family planning benefits, health savings account, flexible spending account, transportation savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, life, accident and disability coverage, business travel accident insurance, employee assistance programs, disability insurance, and other well-being benefits.

Tanium is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected Veteran status, or other legally protected categories. If you require a reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening, completing an application, interviewing, or completing any pre-employment testing or requirements, please contact [accommodations@tanium.com](mailto:accommodations@tanium.com). For more information refer to the “Know Your Rights” poster which is available here - [https://www.eeoc.gov/poster](https://www.eeoc.gov/poster).

Please be aware of job offers coming from people claiming to be Tanium employees. Tanium employees will only use @tanium.com email addresses to communicate with you, will have video interviews with you, and will never ask you for money.

The machine-readable files are formatted to allow researchers, regulators, and application developers to more easily access and analyze data.

Posting Type

Hybrid

Job Overview

The Lead Systems Administrator on the IT Operations Endpoint Engineering team is a senior, direct technical leader responsible for the reliability, security, and scalability of the company’s endpoint ecosystem. This role ensures endpoints are managed and secured as a critical “front door” to corporate systems.

Job Description and Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1) Endpoint Management Platform Ownership

Own and continuously improve endpoint management capabilities that enable secure, scalable provisioning, configuration, compliance, and software delivery across the endpoint fleet.

Lead initiatives and operational maturity in areas such as Intune optimization, Autopilot improvements, and endpoint analytics/advanced reporting.

Drive platform reliability and prevent issues through initiative-taking monitoring, health checks, and lifecycle management of endpoint tooling.

2) Endpoint Security Baselines & Vulnerability Reduction

Implement and support endpoint security controls and hardening baselines in partnership with Security teams, with an emphasis on measurable risk reduction and audit readiness.

Lead vulnerability response workstreams such as vulnerability remediation programs, and security tool integrations.

Implement and maintain enterprise security expectations while preserving end-user productivity and operational continuity.

3) Provisioning, Deployment, and Change Execution at Scale

Own endpoint provisioning workflows and zero-touch/low-touch deployment practices.

Partners with adjacent teams to ensure endpoint changes are aligned with compliance, required controls and Security expectations.

4) Tier 3/4 Escalation, Incident Response, and Problem Management

Function as a top-level escalation point for complex endpoint incidents impacting Enterprise systems.

Lead root cause analysis efforts and implements durable fixes to prevent repeated incidents and reduces support burden.

5) Automation & Operational Excellence

Build and support automation to reduce repetitive manual work and improve consistency.

Establish and enforce best practices that optimize for scale and improve end-user outcomes.

6) Documentation, Knowledge Transfer, and Enablement

Create and support runbooks, operational playbooks, and high-quality documentation.

Provide technical enablement to Service Desk and partner teams to reduce escalations and increase first-contact resolution.

7) Cross-Team Collaboration & Stakeholder Partnership

Collaborate across IT Operations and Security, recognizing that Endpoint Engineering work has broad impact and multiple internal “customers.”

Partner with Security, vendors, and internal IT teams to execute endpoint projects and platform improvements.

Contribute to committing roadmaps and delivery processes in areas including endpoint modernization and least privileged access improvements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Demonstrated experience leading endpoint administration/engineering work in an enterprise environment.

Strong troubleshooting capability across endpoint policy/configuration, deployment workflows, and large-scale endpoint operational issues.

Proven ability to document processes, develop operational standards, and improve systems through being initiative-taking instead of reactive.

Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to work effectively across IT Ops and Security stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Job Description An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we re committed to being a great place to work one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

Position Summary

The Senior Platforms Engineer is responsible for the strategic design, deployment, and optimization of complex infrastructure platforms and systems, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security. This qualified candidate will have proven experience as a technical lead or platform owner for digital workplace or AI initiatives.

This role will maintain ownership throughout the entire lifecycle of AI agents and automation, handling intake, governance, versioning, monitoring, and retirement in production environments. An expected focus of this role is to deliver impactful AI value and usage reports, presenting productivity improvements, risk assessments, and cost optimization metrics to leadership and business stakeholders.

This role leads advanced troubleshooting, performance tuning, and technical support activities, serving as the primary escalation point for complex issues and collaborating across teams to drive continuous improvement. The Senior Platforms Engineer also oversees resiliency, disaster recovery and backup strategies, develops comprehensive reporting frameworks, and ensures compliance with industry standards and best practices.

The candidate will have designed and implemented secure, enterprise-grade low-code applications for regulated and sensitive data, ensuring compliance and robust protection measures.

Additionally, this position fosters a culture of knowledge sharing by mentoring junior engineers, organizing training sessions, and promoting cross-functional collaboration to enhance documentation and information sharing.

This position belongs to a family of jobs with increasing responsibility, competency, and skill level. Actual position title and pay grade will be based on the selected candidate s experience and qualifications.

Key Responsibilities

Identifies performance bottlenecks, conducts root cause analysis, and proposes and implements solutions to enhance platform & system performance and resource utilization. Establishes performance benchmarks, conducts capacity planning, and collaborates with other teams, including junior engineers and cross functional teams to optimize infrastructure performance and activities.
Contributes to the development and improvement of troubleshooting procedures, measures to minimize platform & system downtime, and documentation. Partners with technical support to drive for resolution. Leads and manages platform & system technical support activities and troubleshooting efforts, including handling escalated and complex issues. Performs advanced system tuning and optimization to maximize performance using IT Service Management practices. Collaborates with Systems and Solution Architects, Governance, Regulatory and Compliance as well as other organizational teams to enhance support processes and methodologies.
Participates in future platform & system backup planning. Leads the design of disaster/system recovery and testing.
Analyzes Power Platform, Copilot Studio, AI agent, and digital workplace platform performance and utilization data to identify trends and patterns. Provides recommendations for optimization, cost efficiency, reliability, and value realization. Prepares executive ready reporting and drives corrective actions to continuously improve platform and AI service outcomes.
Leads development of advanced troubleshooting procedures and operational runbooks for Power Platform solutions, AI agents, and automations. Serves as the primary escalation point for complex platform, automation, or agent issues. Coordinates with vendors and internal teams to resolve incidents and continuously improve service reliability and operational maturity.
Leads the creation and maintenance of a comprehensive knowledge base for platforms & systems, including troubleshooting guides, configuration documentation, and best practices. Promotes knowledge sharing culture by organizing training sessions, mentoring junior engineers, and encouraging cross-team collaboration.

Education and Experience

Bachelor s Degree in Information Technology, related field or equivalent experience required
Five (5) or more years of relevant experience required.

Administered and supported Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Agents, Azure Services) in enterprise environments highly preferred.
Experience applying automation design patterns, managed error handling, monitoring, and provided operational support for platforms highly preferred.
Developed and delivered platform usage, reliability, and adoption reporting for leadership and stakeholders preferred.
Implemented environment strategies, solution packaging, and application lifecycle management practices for low-code platforms preferred.
Managed security, identity, and access controls within Microsoft 365 and Power Platform preferred.

Skills

Cloud Infrastructure Management - Setting up, configuring, monitoring, and optimizing the components of cloud infrastructure.
Computer Networking - A system in which multiple computers are connected to each other to share information and resources.
Cybersecurity Risk Management - The process of developing cyber risk assessment and treatment techniques that can effectively pre-empt and identify significant security loopholes and weaknesses, demonstrating the business risks associated with these loopholes and providing risk treatment and prioritization strategies to effectively address the cyber-related risks, threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring appropriate levels of protection, confidentiality, integrity and privacy in alignment with the security framework.
DevSecOps - A set of practices that automates the integration of security at every phase of the software development lifecycle, from initial design through integration, testing, deployment, and software delivery, with an aim towards shortening the systems development life cycle and pas well as continuous delivery and a security first approach.
General Programming - Applies a computer language to communicate with computers using a set of instructions and to automate the execution of tasks.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) - The process of managing and provisioning infrastructure through code instead of through manual processes.
IT Infrastructure Management - Planning, design, delivery and control of information technology infrastructure.
Performance Monitoring - The process of measuring the performance of a system in real time in order to determine problems and identify other factors that may cause problems in the future.
Policy Management - The process of creating, implementing and maintaining policies and procedures within an organization.
Process Automation - Also known as business automation or digital transformation, this is the technology-enabled automation of complex business processes. It can streamline a business for simplicity, achieve digital transformation, increase service quality, improve service delivery or contain costs. It consists of integrating applications, restructuring labor resources and using software applications throughout the organization.
Service Delivery Management - The manner in which an organization provides users access to IT services, which include applications, data storage and other business resources.
Systems Administration - Performs a variety of functions including user management, system monitoring, system configuration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and access control.
System Platform- A system platform refers to the underlying foundation or framework that supports and manages the operation of software applications and hardware components within a computing environment. It provides a standardized and cohesive infrastructure, allowing for the development, deployment, and integration of various technologies and services.
Systems Testing - The process of testing conducted on a complete integrated system to evaluate the system's compliance with its specified requirements.
Systems Integration - The process of linking together various IT systems, services and/or software to enable all of them to work functionally together.
Troubleshooting - The act or process of discovering and resolving problems, disputes, or mechanical issues through a systematic, usually iterative, approach.
AI Platform Reliability &
• Incident Management Operating AI agents and automation platforms in production, including incident response, root cause analysis, and post incident remediation.

Enterprise ALM &
• Release Management Managing solution promotion, version control, and coordinated releases for low code and AI solutions across environments.

Data Integration &
• Connector Strategy Integrating Power Platform and AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, and data sources while managing connector risk and performance.

Identity, Access &
• Permissions Modeling Designing and enforcing role based access, service accounts, managed identities, and secure permission models.

Cost Awareness &
• Optimization (FinOps) Monitoring usage patterns and identifying optimization opportunities for AI, automation, and platform services.

Platform Standardization &
• Pattern Development Defining reusable patterns, reference architectures, and templates for AI agents, workflows, and low code applications.

Change Management &
• Adoption Enablement Supporting rollout, operational readiness, and adoption of AI enabled digital workplace capabilities.

Vendor &
• Third Party Platform Coordination Partnering with vendors to resolve issues, influence roadmaps, and evaluate emerging capabilities.

Risk Assessment &
• Compliance Alignment Assessing AI and platform solutions against security, privacy, regulatory, and audit requirements.

Technical Communication &
• Executive Readouts Translating platform and AI operational data into clear, decision ready insights for leadership.
