jobs.description:
En **Tekton Labs** nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a **Senior Data Architect** especializado/a en Master Data Management (MDM) e Ingeniería de Datos para liderar el diseño y estructuración del modelo unificado de datos de una importante compañía internacional del sector industrial. En este rol consultivo y de ejecución técnica, serás el pilar fundamental para consolidar información fragmentada proveniente de más de 15 orígenes de datos heterogéneos en un *Golden Record* sólido sobre PostgreSQL. Tu trabajo garantizará la calidad, gobernanza y trazabilidad del modelo de datos corporativo, definiendo además la hoja de ruta técnica para dimensionar el equipo de ingeniería que escalará la solución.

**Offer:** Contractor: USD 4000.00

**Timezone:** (UTC-05:00) Lima, Peru - Peru Time (PET)

**English Level:** A1 - Beginner

**Spanish Level:** C2 - Native

**Responsibilities:**

* Levantar y documentar la arquitectura actual de datos, incluyendo fuentes, integraciones, transformaciones, dependencias y principales brechas.
* Diseñar y documentar la arquitectura de datos corporativa y el modelo de Master Data Management (MDM) enfocado inicialmente en los dominios de clientes y productos, concebido como Single Source of Truth (SSOT) para la organización.
* Diseñar modelos conceptuales, lógicos y físicos, así como la estructura de objetos, tablas y esquemas relacionales en PostgreSQL (on-premise) para la base de datos de consolidación.
* Diseñar reglas de negocio, lógica de coincidencia (matching), deduplicación, supervivencia (survivorship), identificadores globales y trazabilidad hacia los sistemas origen para la generación del Golden Record.
* Diseñar un modelo de MDM genérico y parametrizable que permita incorporar nuevos dominios maestros en fases posteriores.
* Estructurar e integrar pipelines de datos (ETL/ELT) orquestados mediante Apache Airflow desde fuentes heterogéneas (ERPs, plataformas SaaS y desarrollos in-house).
* Liderar sesiones de discovery técnico con Data Owners, Data Stewards y usuarios clave de negocio para el levantamiento de reglas y validación de requerimientos.
* Establecer lineamientos corporativos para Data Quality, Data Governance, Metadata y Data Lineage.
* Identificar quick wins, priorizar requerimientos y construir el backlog técnico para las siguientes fases del proyecto.
* Cuantificar el alcance real del proyecto durante la fase inicial para dimensionar la cantidad y seniority del equipo de Data Engineers requerido.
* Participar junto al equipo de Tekton Labs en la evaluación técnica y selección de los ingenieros de datos que se sumarán al proyecto.
* Actuar como referente técnico y consultivo durante la evolución e implementación de One Vision.

**Must have:**

* Experiencia profesional mínima de 3 años como Data Architect, Lead Data Engineer o rol consultivo equivalente.
* Experiencia sólida en el diseño e implementación de soluciones de Master Data Management (MDM) y modelos de Golden Record.
* Dominio avanzado en modelado de datos y administración de PostgreSQL.
* Capacidad demostrable de desarrollo de scripts en Python y SQL avanzado.
* Experiencia previa diseñando procesos de integración, transformación e ingesta de datos (ETL/ELT).
* Experiencia integrando datos desde múltiples sistemas empresariales y bases de datos heterogéneas.
* Conocimiento práctico aplicado a marcos de Data Quality, Data Governance, Metadata y Data Lineage.
* Conocimientos en metodologías de control de versiones (Git) e integración continua (CI/CD) aplicadas a datos.
* Familiaridad general con plataformas de datos en la nube (AWS, Databricks, Snowflake o BigQuery).
* Experiencia práctica en orquestación de datos con Apache Airflow.

**Nice to have:**

* Experiencia en entornos corporativos multi-país o empresas del sector industrial / manufacturero.
* Experiencia en proyectos de arquitectura híbrida On-Premise + Cloud.
* Conocimiento de otras plataformas Cloud como GCP, Azure u otras.
* Experiencia implementando MDM en organizaciones con múltiples países, empresas o ERPs.
* Experiencia en arquitecturas orientadas a integración de múltiples sistemas legacy.
* Experiencia diseñando frameworks o motores MDM reutilizables y parametrizables.
* Experiencia liderando técnicamente o realizando coaching a equipos de Data Engineering.
* Experiencia diseñando Semantic Layers o plataformas de Self-Service Analytics.
* Familiaridad con arquitecturas orientadas a AI/ML, Generative AI o Agentic AI.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR, LAUNCH

SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and knowledgeable IT Systems Administrator to support the networking, compute administration, and application support needs of our launch environment. This role will be pivotal to the enablement of safe and sustained launch cadence, directly supporting our goals of making humanity a multiplanetary species. Candidate must be comfortable working on mission-critical systems with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities while maintaining attention to detail and operational excellence.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Augment and deploy new IT infrastructure, including networking, server, and desktop hardware directly supporting mission critical networks across the country.

- Perform periodic systems upgrades and patches in between critical operations, sometimes on weekends and evenings.

- Monitor IT services and respond aggressively to incidents to maintain systems performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with systems deployments.

- Author and maintain documentation for IT systems, from systems overview documents and design drawings to procedures.

- Leverage automation tools and contribute to IT systems engineering efforts.

- Ensure that systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g. ITAR, ISO, NIST).

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

- 3+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Hands-on experience with Linux or Windows server administration.

- Experience with enterprise network administration and deployment.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Working knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP, PTP etc), firewalls administration and cybersecurity technologies.

- Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Powershell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet).

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identification environments.

- Experience with virtualization platforms and tools.

- Understanding of Layer 1 configuration best practices and multiplexing technologies.

- Working knowledge, including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot, Windows-based systems and services (i.e. SCCM, Active Directory).

- Exposure to real-time systems and industrial telemetry networks.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg.

- Must have valid driver's license.

- Willing to work extended hours or weekends as necessary.

- Willing to be on after-hours on-call rotation.

- Ability to lift up to 30lbs.

- Ability to work at heights.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

Position: Desktop Engineer III/ Endpoint Engineer
Location: Schaumburg, IL
Duration: 12 Months plus contract
Rate: DOE

Job Description

The Endpoint Engineer will focus on delivery of a consistent product and computing experience to the clients' workforce. The Engineer will focus on designing, building, and implementing endpoint configurations and user applications across both virtual and physical desktop environments. In addition, the Endpoint Engineer will work closely with other End User technicians and engineers in providing Level 3 (tier three) technical support and will serve as an escalation point for core end user endpoint, but will also be tasked at providing guidance, direction, and documentation to the Level 2 (tier two) team.

The individual in this position will also be responsible ensuring that all desktops OS and applications are current, reliable, and accessible in accordance with service level agreements. Job Description An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we re committed to being a great place to work one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

Position Summary

The Senior Platforms Engineer is responsible for the strategic design, deployment, and optimization of complex infrastructure platforms and systems, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security. This qualified candidate will have proven experience as a technical lead or platform owner for digital workplace or AI initiatives.

This role will maintain ownership throughout the entire lifecycle of AI agents and automation, handling intake, governance, versioning, monitoring, and retirement in production environments. An expected focus of this role is to deliver impactful AI value and usage reports, presenting productivity improvements, risk assessments, and cost optimization metrics to leadership and business stakeholders.

This role leads advanced troubleshooting, performance tuning, and technical support activities, serving as the primary escalation point for complex issues and collaborating across teams to drive continuous improvement. The Senior Platforms Engineer also oversees resiliency, disaster recovery and backup strategies, develops comprehensive reporting frameworks, and ensures compliance with industry standards and best practices.

The candidate will have designed and implemented secure, enterprise-grade low-code applications for regulated and sensitive data, ensuring compliance and robust protection measures.

Additionally, this position fosters a culture of knowledge sharing by mentoring junior engineers, organizing training sessions, and promoting cross-functional collaboration to enhance documentation and information sharing.

This position belongs to a family of jobs with increasing responsibility, competency, and skill level. Actual position title and pay grade will be based on the selected candidate s experience and qualifications.

Key Responsibilities

Identifies performance bottlenecks, conducts root cause analysis, and proposes and implements solutions to enhance platform & system performance and resource utilization. Establishes performance benchmarks, conducts capacity planning, and collaborates with other teams, including junior engineers and cross functional teams to optimize infrastructure performance and activities.
Contributes to the development and improvement of troubleshooting procedures, measures to minimize platform & system downtime, and documentation. Partners with technical support to drive for resolution. Leads and manages platform & system technical support activities and troubleshooting efforts, including handling escalated and complex issues. Performs advanced system tuning and optimization to maximize performance using IT Service Management practices. Collaborates with Systems and Solution Architects, Governance, Regulatory and Compliance as well as other organizational teams to enhance support processes and methodologies.
Participates in future platform & system backup planning. Leads the design of disaster/system recovery and testing.
Analyzes Power Platform, Copilot Studio, AI agent, and digital workplace platform performance and utilization data to identify trends and patterns. Provides recommendations for optimization, cost efficiency, reliability, and value realization. Prepares executive ready reporting and drives corrective actions to continuously improve platform and AI service outcomes.
Leads development of advanced troubleshooting procedures and operational runbooks for Power Platform solutions, AI agents, and automations. Serves as the primary escalation point for complex platform, automation, or agent issues. Coordinates with vendors and internal teams to resolve incidents and continuously improve service reliability and operational maturity.
Leads the creation and maintenance of a comprehensive knowledge base for platforms & systems, including troubleshooting guides, configuration documentation, and best practices. Promotes knowledge sharing culture by organizing training sessions, mentoring junior engineers, and encouraging cross-team collaboration.

Education and Experience

Bachelor s Degree in Information Technology, related field or equivalent experience required
Five (5) or more years of relevant experience required.

Administered and supported Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Agents, Azure Services) in enterprise environments highly preferred.
Experience applying automation design patterns, managed error handling, monitoring, and provided operational support for platforms highly preferred.
Developed and delivered platform usage, reliability, and adoption reporting for leadership and stakeholders preferred.
Implemented environment strategies, solution packaging, and application lifecycle management practices for low-code platforms preferred.
Managed security, identity, and access controls within Microsoft 365 and Power Platform preferred.

Skills

Cloud Infrastructure Management - Setting up, configuring, monitoring, and optimizing the components of cloud infrastructure.
Computer Networking - A system in which multiple computers are connected to each other to share information and resources.
Cybersecurity Risk Management - The process of developing cyber risk assessment and treatment techniques that can effectively pre-empt and identify significant security loopholes and weaknesses, demonstrating the business risks associated with these loopholes and providing risk treatment and prioritization strategies to effectively address the cyber-related risks, threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring appropriate levels of protection, confidentiality, integrity and privacy in alignment with the security framework.
DevSecOps - A set of practices that automates the integration of security at every phase of the software development lifecycle, from initial design through integration, testing, deployment, and software delivery, with an aim towards shortening the systems development life cycle and pas well as continuous delivery and a security first approach.
General Programming - Applies a computer language to communicate with computers using a set of instructions and to automate the execution of tasks.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) - The process of managing and provisioning infrastructure through code instead of through manual processes.
IT Infrastructure Management - Planning, design, delivery and control of information technology infrastructure.
Performance Monitoring - The process of measuring the performance of a system in real time in order to determine problems and identify other factors that may cause problems in the future.
Policy Management - The process of creating, implementing and maintaining policies and procedures within an organization.
Process Automation - Also known as business automation or digital transformation, this is the technology-enabled automation of complex business processes. It can streamline a business for simplicity, achieve digital transformation, increase service quality, improve service delivery or contain costs. It consists of integrating applications, restructuring labor resources and using software applications throughout the organization.
Service Delivery Management - The manner in which an organization provides users access to IT services, which include applications, data storage and other business resources.
Systems Administration - Performs a variety of functions including user management, system monitoring, system configuration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and access control.
System Platform- A system platform refers to the underlying foundation or framework that supports and manages the operation of software applications and hardware components within a computing environment. It provides a standardized and cohesive infrastructure, allowing for the development, deployment, and integration of various technologies and services.
Systems Testing - The process of testing conducted on a complete integrated system to evaluate the system's compliance with its specified requirements.
Systems Integration - The process of linking together various IT systems, services and/or software to enable all of them to work functionally together.
Troubleshooting - The act or process of discovering and resolving problems, disputes, or mechanical issues through a systematic, usually iterative, approach.
AI Platform Reliability &
• Incident Management Operating AI agents and automation platforms in production, including incident response, root cause analysis, and post incident remediation.

Enterprise ALM &
• Release Management Managing solution promotion, version control, and coordinated releases for low code and AI solutions across environments.

Data Integration &
• Connector Strategy Integrating Power Platform and AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, and data sources while managing connector risk and performance.

Identity, Access &
• Permissions Modeling Designing and enforcing role based access, service accounts, managed identities, and secure permission models.

Cost Awareness &
• Optimization (FinOps) Monitoring usage patterns and identifying optimization opportunities for AI, automation, and platform services.

Platform Standardization &
• Pattern Development Defining reusable patterns, reference architectures, and templates for AI agents, workflows, and low code applications.

Change Management &
• Adoption Enablement Supporting rollout, operational readiness, and adoption of AI enabled digital workplace capabilities.

Vendor &
• Third Party Platform Coordination Partnering with vendors to resolve issues, influence roadmaps, and evaluate emerging capabilities.

Risk Assessment &
• Compliance Alignment Assessing AI and platform solutions against security, privacy, regulatory, and audit requirements.

Technical Communication &
• Executive Readouts Translating platform and AI operational data into clear, decision ready insights for leadership.

jobs.description:
Performance Drone Works (PDW) is building the next generation of tactical robotic systems used across defense, national security, and public safety missions. We are building a new center of engineering excellence to design our new category of tactical robotic systems and the industrial capacity to deliver them, bringing decisive airpower into the hands of every operator. We are not here to make promises; we are here to deliver real systems with real capabilities for real missions.

You will join a team of operators, engineers, and builders who solve hard problems with humility and focus. We design and produce multi-mission aerial systems that operators trust to perform in real-world conditions, reliably, repeatedly, and at scale. Our approach is grounded in operator-centered design, rapid iteration from field use, and U.S.-based manufacturing. We operate by a clear set of values: Mission First, Aim Farther, Own It, Win Together. This is how we build advantage and how we help protect our service members, our communities, and our country.

Now, we’re entering a new phase of growth and are looking for an Endpoint Management Administrator to join our growing Information Technology team.

What You’ll Do

Configure, image, and prepare laptops, desktops, tablets, and mobile devices for new hires and refresh cycles.Ensure assigned devices receive the correct profiles, configurations, applications, compliance policies, and baseline assignments based on role or department.Administer endpoint management for Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android devices through Microsoft Intune, Jamf, and related tools.Monitor device compliance, patch status, encryption, antivirus, and overall security posture.Apply, validate, and troubleshoot configuration profiles, policies, applications, endpoint agents, remediation scripts, and baseline assignments.Respond to compliance alerts and execute device remediation tasks.Manage mobile application management policies for corporate and BYOD mobile access, including Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace app protection configurations.Maintain documentation for imaging, configuration, troubleshooting, and escalation workflows.Partner with IT Operations, Identity, and Security teams on endpoint standards, device trust, conditional access, and access policy requirements.

Requirements

2–4 years of experience in device management, endpoint administration, MDM/UEM administration, or related IT operations within an enterprise environment.Hands‑on experience provisioning and imaging laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.Proficiency with MDM/UEM platforms such as Intune, Jamf, or similar administration tools. Strong understanding of compliance management, encryption, patch status, and endpoint security posture.Ability to deploy, update, and troubleshoot applications across multiple platforms.Strong troubleshooting skills across device performance, system errors, connectivity, and software issues.Experience collecting logs and performing root cause analysis.Familiarity with security tools, conditional access, antivirus, and compliance workflows.Experience with asset lifecycle management including inventory, refreshes, and disposals. Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with cross functional teams.Ability to create and maintain documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base content.Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance.

Preferred

Experience with advanced Intune administration, remediation scripts, reporting, or automation.Knowledge of macOS administration via Jamf or cross platform UEM solutions.Exposure to scripting (PowerShell, Bash) for endpoint automation or remediation.Background in regulated or fast paced IT environments (manufacturing, defense, engineering, etc.).

Work Environment

This position includes the following:Operates primarily in a professional, climate-controlled office, warehouse, manufacturing and shipping environment. At times, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as safety gloves, goggles, and hearing protection may be required.Employee will also work outdoors to load and receive shipments, where they may be exposed to the elements, including heat, rain, and cold.Standard hours are Monday through Friday 7:00AM to 3:30PM, with occasional overtime as operational needs may require.Fast paced environment with moving, packing, and staging shipments

Benefits

PDW values our team, and we offer a compensation package reflective of your experience and capabilities. Benefits include:

Comprehensive BCBS medical, dental, and vision coverage; 80% sponsored by the company. Safe Harbor 401(K) with company match. Paid Parental Leave. On-site gym at Huntsville, AL & Denver, CO locations. Employer provided life insurance. Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP). A work environment that encourages teamwork and innovation. Competitive salary, generous paid time off (PTO), and flexible leave options.

EEO Statement

PDW is an equal opportunity employer that upholds all federal and state non-discrimination laws. We ensure a fair and unbiased evaluation for employment for all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, medical condition, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
About Aspira

For more than 40 years, Aspira has been the market-leading provider of software and services that help public agencies protect natural and cultural resources while making them accessible for all. Our platform supports everything from campground reservations to hunting licenses, helping millions of people discover, enjoy, and care for the outdoors.

We share our client partners’ mission: to steward resources for future generations, create opportunities for genuine enjoyment of the outdoors today, and expand access so more people can experience its benefits.

Aspira is transforming its technology and service model to give agencies more capacity and insight—streamlined tools, smarter automation, and better connections with their communities. Our goal is simple: make it easier for our clients to conserve what matters most and for their customers to enjoy it to the fullest.

FYI

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Aspira is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas, now or in the future.

As part of our hiring process, candidates may be required to complete an identity verification check conducted through Checkr, a secure third-party service provider. This step helps confirm the authenticity of applicant identities and supports a fair, secure hiring process for all candidates.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this notice and consent to the potential inclusion of an identity verification step as part of the interview process.

The Ideal Candidate

We're looking for a curious, analytical, and self-driven Platform Solutions Engineer to join our Enterprise Platforms team. This isn't a traditional support role or one focused on mastering a single technology — it's about solving business problems by connecting systems, automating processes, and designing scalable technical solutions across cloud platforms, contact center systems, and enterprise applications.

You may be asked to solve a problem involving AWS, Amazon Connect, ServiceNow, Jira, a third-party SaaS platform, or a system you've never worked with before. You don't need to know every technology on day one. You do need to know how to learn, investigate, connect the dots, and determine the best path from a business requirement to a working technical solution.

The ideal candidate is someone who naturally asks, "How can we make this better?" and can independently figure out how to make it happen.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Engineering & Integration

Design, build, and maintain integrations between enterprise applications using APIs, webhooks, middleware, and modern integration patterns. Develop and maintain serverless solutions on AWS, including planning and executing runtime upgrade and migration projects for deprecated services. Design and maintain Amazon Connect contact flows and routing logic across multiple markets and queues. Architect notification and messaging workflows to support customer- and agent-facing use cases such as availability alerts and status updates. Participate in the implementation and integration of new / existing enterprise platforms.

Process Improvement & Automation

Analyze existing workflows and identify opportunities for automation and optimization, favoring reusable solutions over one-off fixes. Design and implement ServiceNow automations to enforce clean ticket lifecycle states, ITIL-aligned status transitions, and QA review processes. Design and implement AI-powered workflows and intelligent automation across business platforms, integrating AI services. Document architecture, workflows, and integration designs.

Collaboration

Work closely with Platform Managers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, Contact Center Operations, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions. Participate in solution design discussions and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications

4+ years of experience in software development, platform engineering, automation, systems integration, or a related technical field. Experience designing, building, deploying and integrating cloud-based applications and services using APIs. Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

Required Hardware and Software Competencies

You will primarily work with AWS, Amazon Connect, ServiceNow, Jira, and other enterprise platforms. Deep expertise in every technology is not expected on day one. Curiosity, problem-solving ability, and the ability to learn quickly are essential.

Cloud (AWS)

Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, EventBridge, Athena, SNS, End User Messaging, CloudFront, S3, Lex, etc.

Contact Center

Amazon Connect

Enterprise Platforms

ServiceNow, Jira, Office365, WFM Tools

Integration

REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, Webhooks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar AI integration frameworks

Development

Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Git

AI

AI Agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt engineering, Intelligent workflow automation

jobs.description:
### **Company Overview**

ID.me is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with ID.me once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 152 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with ID.me at 20 federal agencies, 45 state government agencies, and 70+ healthcare organizations. More than 600+ consumer brands use ID.me to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. ID.me’s technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. ID.me is committed to “No Identity Left Behind” to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit [https://network.id.me/](https://network.id.me/).

ID.me is a full-time, in-office culture. ## IT Engineer, IT Operations

### Role Overview

We are seeking an **IT Engineer** to join our **IT Operations team** — the group that keeps the core systems a ~1,000-person company runs on, reliable, secure, and continuously improving. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who takes ownership end to end: you will build the integrations and automations that connect our IT and business platforms, keep critical services highly available, and be a dependable technical resource the rest of the team can rely on.

You will operate with a high degree of autonomy. Much of the work here isn't handed to you fully specified — you will investigate unfamiliar systems, reverse-engineer how things fit together in a fast-moving environment, and decide what's worth doing next. You will ship pragmatically, favoring solid, incremental improvements that land over perfect solutions that don't, and you will keep Security, Compliance, and Data close so everything you build stays governed. Throughout, you will raise issues early, communicate clearly with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and help the people around you.

If you like owning hard problems in a complex environment, working independently, and being the calm, capable engineer a team is glad to have, this is a meaningful opportunity to shape how our IT organization operates.

### Role Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain integrations and automations that connect our IT and business systems, eliminating manual, repetitive work.
- Administer, configure, and optimize core IT platforms and business SaaS applications, ensuring consistent performance and reliability.
- Script and deploy solutions organization-wide (Python, Bash, or similar) and automate repeatable operational processes.
- Integrate systems through APIs and webhooks — handling authentication, rate limits, retries, and error cases.
- Handle advanced technical troubleshooting across IT systems, endpoints, identity, and integrations, and support escalations from the IT Support team.
- Implement proactive measures for high availability, monitor system performance, and remediate availability and performance issues before users feel them.
- Contribute to disaster recovery planning and execution, ensuring swift restoration of critical services.
- Proactively identify improvements to systems and processes, then scope and deliver them without waiting to be told.
- Create and maintain clear documentation, configuration standards, and runbooks for both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Partner with engineering, security, and compliance teams to develop responsible, well-governed solutions.
- Share knowledge with teammates and contribute to the overall capability of the IT Operations team.
- Communicate technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs clearly and calmly to teammates and stakeholders.
- Perform other duties as assigned to meet team and organizational needs.

### Required Skills / Abilities

- 3+ years of hands-on experience as an IT / systems engineer (or similar) in an enterprise environment, able to carry technical work independently.
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
- Strong API fluency (REST / JSON, OAuth, webhooks) and the ability to read and write code in Python, Bash, or similar.
- Demonstrated experience integrating and automating across SaaS platforms and business systems.
- Experience with applying AI and LLM-based automation to reduce operational toil.
- A self-starter who works with a high degree of autonomy — identifies what needs doing, gathers context independently, and drives it to completion.
- Comfortable operating amid ambiguity and incomplete documentation, quickly building understanding of unfamiliar and fast-changing systems.
- Solid fundamentals in systems administration, corporate directory / identity, networking, and endpoint management.
- Excellent written and verbal communication, with the maturity to keep stakeholders informed and to raise risks constructively.
- A pragmatic, iterative delivery style — ship "good enough, then iterate" rather than stalling on perfection.

### Ideal Qualifications

_The qualifications below are ideal, but not all are required. We encourage candidates to apply if they satisfy some, but not all of these qualifications._

- Experience with MDM solutions (Jamf, Intune) and supporting macOS at scale.
- Familiarity with modern automation and workflow tooling, and version control systems.
- Experience with monitoring, observability, and building resilient, highly available services.
- Relevant industry certifications.

jobs.description:
Minnesota - Software Engineer

Hollstadt Overview
Hollstadt Consulting is a management and technology consulting firm dedicated to placing professionals at engagements where they will excel. When you work with us, you'll work with a refreshingly real company led and staffed by seasoned experts who are also down-to-earth, good people. We're committed to treating you with respect and helping you achieve your career aspirations.

Since 1990, Hollstadt has been a trusted partner to more than 150 domestic and global companies and has successfully completed over 3,000 projects. Our continued growth has created challenging and rewarding opportunities for accomplished IT and Business Consultants. Hollstadt Consulting is an equal opportunity employer including disability/veteran.

By applying for this job, you agree to receive calls, AI-generated calls, text messages, or emails from Hollstadt Consulting and its affiliates, and contracted partners. Frequency varies for text messages. Message and data rates may apply. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. You can reply STOP to cancel at any time.

Job Description

Role: End User Compute Engineer

Location: Onsite in Lakeville, MN, with travel to Northfield, MN 1 day every 3 weeks

Duration: 1 year

Rate: $35/hour W2

Position Summary

We are seeking an End User Compute Engineer to provide hands-on technical support and endpoint management for a growing enterprise environment. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical issues, delivering exceptional customer experiences, and serving as a trusted technology partner across the organization.

You will support a broad range of end-user technologies, including desktops, laptops, mobile devices, collaboration platforms, and conference room technologies. In addition to day-to-day support, you'll play an important role in improving endpoint management, patching strategies, conference room reliability, and overall user productivity.

This opportunity offers a mix of technical troubleshooting, executive support, endpoint administration, cross-functional collaboration, and process improvement, making it an excellent fit for someone who enjoys both operational support and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

End User Support & Issue Resolution

Resolve technical issues from a prioritized support queue, ensuring timely and professional service.
Troubleshoot complex hardware, software, networking, and end-user computing issues across Windows, macOS, mobile devices, printers, phones, and peripherals.
Provide support for both onsite and remote employees while maintaining a consistent user experience across locations.
Deliver high-touch support to senior leaders and key stakeholders when required.
Communicate clearly with users, provide status updates, and ensure issues are fully resolved.

Collaboration & Meeting Technology Support

Support, maintain, and troubleshoot conference room technologies, including Microsoft Teams Rooms, video conferencing systems, digital displays, projectors, and related AV equipment.
Ensure meeting rooms are operational, reliable, and ready for business-critical meetings.
Assist with deployment and optimization of collaboration technologies across multiple sites.

Endpoint Administration & Device Management

Configure, deploy, secure, and support endpoint devices in accordance with enterprise standards.
Utilize endpoint management platforms such as Intune, ManageEngine, or similar tools to manage devices and software.
Support endpoint security initiatives, including BitLocker, multi-factor authentication, single sign-on technologies, and compliance requirements.
Develop and enhance endpoint patching and software deployment processes to improve reliability and reduce risk.

IT Operations & Cross-Functional Partnership

Collaborate with infrastructure, security, application, and productivity teams to resolve complex technical issues.
Support enterprise technology initiatives, including software rollouts, system upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
Manage and prioritize requests through the IT service management platform.
Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures.

Continuous Improvement

Identify recurring issues, analyze trends, and recommend long-term solutions.
Conduct proactive system checks and preventative maintenance activities.
Help improve support processes, workflows, and user experiences across the organization.
Provide training, guidance, and knowledge sharing to end users and junior support staff.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience in IT support, desktop engineering, endpoint management, or a similar end-user computing role.
Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows environments, Microsoft 365 applications, mobile devices, hardware, peripherals, and collaboration technologies.
Experience supporting enterprise endpoint technologies, including device configuration, deployment, patching, and lifecycle management.
Experience administering and supporting:

Windows Enterprise environments
Active Directory
Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, Office applications)
Group Policy
BitLocker
Single Sign-On (SSO)
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

Experience with IT ticketing and service management platforms such as ServiceNow or similar tools.
Strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues independently.
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to lift up to 45 pounds when supporting endpoint and conference room equipment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting Microsoft Teams Rooms, conference room technologies, and audio-visual systems.
Experience providing executive or white-glove support to senior leadership.
Familiarity with endpoint management tools such as Intune, ManageEngine, or Lansweeper.
Basic PowerShell scripting experience for automation and administration tasks.
ITIL certification or practical knowledge of ITIL service management principles.
Experience supporting hybrid work environments and remote employees.
Familiarity with compliance, security audits, or regulated environments.
Experience independently leading small endpoint management or user technology improvement projects.

Technical Environment

Candidates can expect to work with technologies including:

Windows Enterprise
Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, Office Suite)
Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR)
Active Directory
Intune
ManageEngine
Lansweeper
ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms
BitLocker
MFA and Single Sign-On technologies
Group Policy
Mobile device management tools
Printers, VoIP phones, and enterprise peripherals
PowerShell
Video conferencing and audio-visual systems

What Success Looks Like

Successful individuals in this role are highly customer-focused and take ownership of issues from initial contact through resolution. They combine strong technical troubleshooting skills with professionalism, empathy, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical users.

You will thrive if you:

Enjoy solving complex technology problems in fast-paced environments.
Build trust through clear communication and follow-through.
Can balance urgent support needs with long-term process improvements.
Work effectively across multiple IT teams and business groups.
Take a proactive approach to identifying risks and preventing issues before they impact users.
Are comfortable supporting everyone from frontline employees to executive leadership.
Continuously seek opportunities to improve technology, processes, and the overall user experience.

Why Join This Opportunity

Play a visible role supporting critical business users and technology solutions.
Work with a broad range of modern endpoint, collaboration, and workplace technologies.
Gain exposure to enterprise-scale IT operations and cross-functional initiatives.
Help shape endpoint management, patching, and support processes that directly impact employee productivity.
Enjoy a varied role that combines hands-on technical support, project work, collaboration technologies, and continuous improvement efforts.
Join a team that values service excellence, operational reliability, and technology innovation.

Travel: Less than 5%

Additional Expectations: Occasional after-hours support and on-call responsibilities as needed.

Benefits + Perks

Comprehensive Benefit Plan

Hollstadt offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, paid sick leave, and retirement benefits to eligible employees. With three different medical plans to choose from, you can enroll in the coverage you need from individual to family, or anywhere in between!

Remarketing Process

Hollstadt is based on retention and relationships. We get to know your strengths and career wishes throughout your assignment and then start remarket discussions 6-8 weeks prior to your end date. By being proactive, we are able to keep your down time between assignments as short as possible, unless you choose otherwise.

Professional Development

Hollstadt offers on-demand training through our consultant portal. Trainings give our consultants the continuing education they need to excel on their projects. Many of our courses apply towards continuing education credits and we have an entire training hub dedicated to upskilling in Artificial Intelligence (AI).

401k + Matching

One popular benefit is our 401(k) match on the first 4% of your contributions. Hollstadt wants to help you reach your long-term financial goals and understands that planning for your future is critical. Consultants also have access to support from a Financial Advisor.

Bonus Opportunities

We appreciate and reward loyalty. Join Hollstadt, stay for 5 years, and we’ll give you a $5,000 Longevity Award bonus! Additionally, we know great talent knows other great talent. If you are on contract with Hollstadt and refer one of your connections who gets placed, we’ll pay you $1,000!

Ongoing Support & Networking

We have made a significant investment in building a support program for our consultant team - so you never have to feel like you are going it alone. We also have a Consultant Coach program which acts like a 'work buddy' to provide a safe ear for questions or concerns at your client site.

jobs.description:
Infrastructure Microsoft & virtualisation dimensionnante & critique – Genève

A PROPOS DU POSTE :

Vous êtes un·e expert·e reconnu·e de l'Active Directory et des infrastructures Microsoft à grande échelle ? Sword recherche un·e System Engineer senior pour concevoir, exploiter et sécuriser l'infrastructure Microsoft d'un client de référence à Genève, dans un environnement exigeant, régulé et fortement sollicité.

Ce poste s'adresse à des profils confirmés ayant conçu et opéré des annuaires Active Directory complexes (multi-domaines, multi-sites, forte volumétrie.

VOS MISSIONS :

• Concevoir, sécuriser et faire évoluer un Active Directory à l'échelle (multi-domaines, multi-sites, réplication, rôles FSMO) et les services cœur associés (DNS, DHCP, DFS, GPO, PKI).

• Assurer le durcissement et la sécurité de l'annuaire (modèle d'administration en tiers, comptes à privilèges, remédiation des risques AD).

• Piloter le déploiement et le patching à grande échelle via SCCM / MECM (packaging, industrialisation).

• Industrialiser et automatiser l'exploitation via PowerShell avancé et Ansible.

• Assurer le monitoring et la gestion des événements sur un parc étendu (SCOM, Nimsoft ou solutions de monitoring d'entreprise équivalentes).

• Contribuer aux environnements Exchange 2019, Microsoft Teams et technologies Citrix.

• Agir en référent technique, participer à la gestion du changement et à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme.

• 7 à 10 ans d'expérience en ingénierie d'infrastructure Microsoft sur des environnements dimensionnants et critiques.

• Expertise avérée en Active Directory à l'échelle, sécurisation/durcissement de l'annuaire, PKI et SCCM.

• Maîtrise confirmée du scripting PowerShell avancé ; solides compétences Ansible.

• Expérience de projets d'envergure et de contextes régulés (posture de référent).

• Atouts : Microsoft 365, Intune, Citrix, MDM (AirWatch ou équivalent).

• Français courant, anglais technique. Résidence suisse requise.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS :

• Une mission longue durée à forte valeur ajoutée chez un client de référence à Genève.

• Un environnement technique riche, exigeant et à la hauteur de votre expertise.

• Un accompagnement et un plan de certifications Microsoft avancées.

• Des perspectives d'évolution au sein du groupe Sword.

Description

About the Role

We’re seeking a sharp, trusted, and highly autonomous Enterprise Solutions Engineer, Channel to help drive NinjaOne’s expansion into the enterprise market. This is a builder role—your chance to shape how we engage complex accounts, scale technical wins, and define what great looks like in enterprise pre-sales. You’ll own the full technical sales cycle—from discovery and architecture through proof-of-concept and implementation—while partnering closely with AEs to influence deal strategy and deliver real-world impact. You won’t just run demos—you’ll build the playbooks, tools, and repeatable processes that help us scale. If you’ve done this before in B2B SaaS, thrive in high-stakes environments, and want your work to directly shape the next chapter of NinjaOne’s growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CT, FL, GA, ME, MA, NJ, NC, NY, OH, TN, & VA.

Travel Requirements - ~50%, including strategic customer meetings, industry events, and team collaboration

What You’ll Be Doing

Own the full pre-sales technical experience for Enterprise Partners, Channel, MSPs & Customers. This will include product demonstrations, architecture design, and key customer engagements to drive deal success. Represent NinjaOne at enterprise-facing industry events, conferences, and customer forums.Support the review and alignment of technical content within RFPs and RFIs without owning full proposal management.Partner with Training and Customer Success teams to accelerate time-to-value and ensure long-term adoption success.Serve as a strategic voice between Sales and Product—surfacing feedback, identifying feature gaps, and influencing roadmap direction.Build and maintain reusable technical assets including lab environments, demo flows, battlecards, and scripts to support a scalable AE-to-SE model.Collaborate closely with Account Executives and Sales Leadership to drive growth and align technical value to business goals.Help shape the future of the Enterprise SE function as a founding member of the team, contributing to playbooks, processes, and cross-functional alignment.Other duties as assigned.

Technical Requirements

Proficiency in Windows environments (registry, services, performance troubleshooting). Familiarity with Linux/macOS systems and basic command-line troubleshooting. Strong understanding of networking concepts, including DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and endpoint protections. Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms and endpoint lifecycle management. Scripting experience in PowerShell, JavaScript, &/or VBScript is strongly preferred. Comfortable navigating complex IT ecosystems and integrating with existing infrastructure. Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Highspot, or equivalent systems is required.

About You

5+ years in a pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting role supporting enterprise B2B SaaS customers.Brings deep domain knowledge in enterprise IT operations, RMM, endpoint management, and ITSM-adjacent platforms.Evolved from a technical background (e.g., TAM, support, systems engineer), with practical insight into IT operations at scale.Strong communicator with executive presence—able to tailor messaging for admins, architects, and senior business stakeholders.Understands how IT teams evaluate, implement, and scale solutions—along with insight into the limitations of legacy platforms and the shift toward unified, modern alternatives.Known for high emotional intelligence, technical credibility, and a customer-first mindset.Operates well in ambiguity and brings a builder’s mentality to scaling people, processes, and tools.Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required. Technical certifications (e.g., CISSP, Security+, cloud architecture) are a plus.

About Us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries.

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

What You’ll Love

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community.

We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.

We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.

We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.

We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.

We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

Additional Information

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to location, market demands, experience, job-related knowledge, and skills. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage and PTO. For roles based in New Jersey, the base salary hiring range for this position is $140,000 to $140,000 per year with On Target Earnings of $200,000 to $200,000 per year.

jobs.description:
Mission

Objectif du poste : L’architecte Cloud & Digital Workplace chez Microsoft est chargé de définir, de concevoir et de piloter la mise en oeuvre de solutions cloud et d’environnement de travail d’entreprise sur Microsoft Azure et Microsoft 365. Ce poste de direction stratégique et technique combine des compétences en architecture cloud, en environnement de travail moderne, en sécurité, en gestion des identités, en collaboration et en infrastructure afin de fournir des services numériques sécurisés, évolutifs, résilients et centrés sur l’utilisateur.

L’architecte dirige le comité cloud, qui fait office d’instance d’approbation pour l’adoption et le déploiement de nouveaux services cloud au sein du groupe.

Principales responsabilités

Stratégie et architecture cloud

• Définir et maintenir la stratégie et la feuille de route d’entreprise relatives au cloud Microsoft.

• Concevoir des architectures cloud sécurisées, évolutives, hautement disponibles et rentables.

• S’assurer que les solutions cloud sont en adéquation avec les objectifs métier, les exigences de sécurité et les normes de conformité.

• Mettre en place des « Azure Landing Zones » et des modèles de gouvernance du cloud.

Architecture de l’environnement de travail numérique

• Définir la vision et l’architecture de l’environnement de travail numérique.

• Concevoir des plateformes de collaboration et de productivité à l’aide de Microsoft 365.

• Diriger les initiatives de transformation de l’environnement de travail favorisant le travail hybride et à distance.

• Améliorer la productivité des collaborateurs et leur expérience numérique grâce à des services innovants liés à l’environnement de travail.

Identité, sécurité et conformité

• Concevoir la gestion des identités et des accès de l’entreprise à l’aide de Microsoft Entra ID.

• Définir et mettre en oeuvre une sécurité « Zero Trust » Principes de sécurité.

• Concevoir des solutions d’accès conditionnel, de gouvernance des identités, d’authentification multifactorielle (MFA) et de gestion des accès privilégiés.

• Mettre en place des contrôles de sécurité maîtrisant : la suite Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, la prévention des pertes de données (DLP) et la protection des informations.

Garantir la conformité aux réglementations du secteur et aux politiques d’entreprise.

Gestion des terminaux et des appareils

• Définir une stratégie moderne de gestion des terminaux.

• Diriger l’initiative Microsoft Intune.

• Mettre en oeuvre : Windows Autopilot, la gestion des appareils mobiles (MDM), la gestion des applications mobiles (MAM), la sécurité des terminaux et les politiques de conformité des appareils

Leadership technique

• Agir en tant qu’autorité technique senior pour les technologies cloud et d’environnement de travail.

• Diriger les comités d’examen de l’architecture et les comités de gouvernance technique.

• Définir les normes d’ingénierie et les meilleures pratiques.

• Servir de point de relais pour les problèmes techniques critiques.

Votre profil

Qualifications et compétences

• Plus de 10 ans d’expérience dans les infrastructures informatiques, le cloud et les services liés à l’environnement de travail.

• Plus de 5 ans d’expérience dans la conception de solutions cloud Azure.

• Plus de 5 ans d’expérience dans l’architecture d’environnements Microsoft 365 d’entreprise.

• Expérience avérée dans la direction de programmes de transformation numérique et de migration vers le cloud.

• Expérience dans la gestion de plateformes cloud et d’environnement de travail à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

• Solide expérience en matière de sécurité, de conformité et de gestion des identités.

Compétences techniques requises

• Technologies cloud : Microsoft Azure, Azure Landing Zones, Azure Networking, AKS, Azure Virtual Desktop, AzureSurveillance, Azure Backup & Recovery, gouvernance Azure, gestion des coûts Azure.

• Microsoft 365 : Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, OneDrive Entreprise, Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform.

• Sécurité et identité : Microsoft Entra ID, accès conditionnel, gestion des identités privilégiées (PIM), Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, architecture Zero Trust

• Gestion des terminaux : Microsoft Intune, Windows 11, Autopilot, Endpoint Analytics, gestion des appareils mobiles

• Automatisation et DevOps : PowerShell, Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Power Automate, API Microsoft Graph

Certifications souhaitées :

Microsoft Certified : Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Microsoft 365 Certified : Enterprise Administrator Expert

Microsoft Certified : Cybersecurity Architect Expert

Microsoft Certified : Identity and Access Administrator Associate

Microsoft Certified : DevOps Engineer Expert

Microsoft Certified : Power Platform Solution Architect Expert.

jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices.

You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have.

You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows.

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems

- Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace

- Expertise with Mobile Device Management tooling (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet) across a device fleet.

- Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) with a proven track record of automating compliance checks, device configuration, and other IT security tasks.

- Experience managing office network equipment (e.g. Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti), including office buildouts.

- Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 (or similar) standards, paired with a friendly, end-user-focused attitude.

- Prior experience in a high-growth or startup environment.

BONUS

- Experience implement corporate security controls / previous security role experience

- Strong hands-on experience with VPNs, firewalls, and secure network environments, including modern practices such as Zero Trust networking.

- Experience with OSquery and Santa

- Terraform or other infrastructure as code experience.

- Open source contributions (e.g. a tool you built to automate something).

LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior IT Engineer to join our IT Engineering — Device Infrastructure Services team. This role goes beyond technical execution, it requires a strong engineer with excellent project management skills, capable of guiding complex device infrastructure initiatives from concept to delivery. They’ll be responsible for driving endpoint management best practices, leading change management processes, and ensuring a seamless, thoughtful end-user experience in a fast-paced SaaS security environment.

The ideal candidate is not only technically skilled in cloud-hosted endpoint management but also a strategic communicator who can collaborate effectively across teams, engage stakeholders at all levels, and advocate for scalable, secure, and efficient enterprise device solutions. They bring a strong user experience focus to everything they ship — from rollout design to end-user communication.

This role reports to the Team Lead, IT Engineering.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

- 5+ years of technical work experience in an IT role, with 2+ years in an IT engineering or systems administrator role focused on cloud-first endpoint management

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and CI/CD workflows applied to device management In an enterprise fleet at scale (500+ endpoints), meeting security benchmarks such as third-party patch compliance goals.

- Demonstrated senior level experience with Apple MDM platforms e.g Iru

- Hands-on experience designing and shipping automation with agentic or LLM-based components in an IT or device management context — and the judgment to know when existing tooling is the better answer.

- Professional-level scripting abilities in Bash, as well as other shell scripts for endpoint automation and fleet operations

- Hands-on experience implementing device trust principles including phishing-resistant authentication, conditional access, and endpoint compliance policies at scale

Bonus points for:

- Knowledge of IT change management and service management best practices (ITIL, etc.)

- Global-level admin experience with Microsoft Intune

- Ability to script in Powershell

- Admin experience with 1Password Enterprise Password Manager (EPM)

What you can expect:

- Lead the planning and implementation of large-scale device infrastructure projects with broad impact across the organization

- Drive IT Change Management initiatives related to endpoint management, software patching, and fleet operations

- Manage and administer cloud-based Apple MDM platforms (Iru), including custom configuration profiles and advanced policy management

- Apply AI tooling to real infrastructure problems (automated remediation, smarter alerting, reducing the manual toil that slows device ops) and have a hand in deciding where it goes next.

- Own third-party software patching workflows that keep the fleet current with minimal disruption to employees

- Approach all rollouts with a strong user experience focus. Phasing thoughtfully, communicating proactively, and designing for minimal disruption

- Contribute to designing and implementing best practices, policies, and procedures for the Device Infrastructure Services team

- Build relationships with key stakeholders across the organization

- Be available for occasional 24/7 on-call shifts to ensure uninterrupted support and resolve incidents.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $117,000 USD and $164,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $103,000 CAD and $144,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.

Our approach to remote work
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Achieving Truveta’s ambitious mission requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values .

Who We Need

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. We are seeking candidates inspired by the opportunity to securely apply data in the development of real-world health solutions. Beyond core capabilities, we seek problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. We do things the right way. Our commitment to security and compliance assurance cannot be stressed enough. This position is critical to ensuring we are successful.

If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you.

This Opportunity

The successful candidate will design and support solutions that support the company’s Digital Workplace strategy. They will work on leading edge technologies that help modernize endpoint management by leveraging the cloud to quickly deliver end-user improvements.

Responsibilities:

- Device Management: Define, implement and maintain endpoint hardening baselines for Windows, macOS, and Linux systems with MDM such as Microsoft Intune, and JAMF.

- Policy & Hardening: Develop and enforce security policies, standards, and procedures for all endpoint devices. Implement system hardening configurations based on industry best practices.

- Deploy & Manage Security Tools: Implement, configure, and maintain endpoint security solutions, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Extended Detection and Response (XDR), antivirus/anti-malware software, and host-based firewalls.

- Incident Response: Collaborate with IT and Security team to respond to endpoint-related incidents. Triage, remediate, and contain security incidents and threats on endpoints. Perform forensic analysis when necessary.

- Vulnerability Management: Manage the endpoint vulnerability lifecycle, from discovery and assessment to remediation, using scanning tools and patch management systems.

- Patch Management: Design and oversee the deployment of updates, security patches for operating system and applications.

- Automation & Scripting: Develop scripts and automation (e.g., using Python, PowerShell) to streamline security operations, automate repetitive tasks, and improve response times.

- AI Protection: Secure endpoints used for AI development, including devices accessing model weights, training data, and production inference systems, implementing guardrails on AI tool usage (e.g., prompt injection prevention in local LLM dev tools, restricted plugins/add-ons).

- Data Loss Prevention: Enforce data loss prevention (DLP) and encryption policies on devices used to handle sensitive AI training datasets, including PHI/PII and proprietary corporation data.

- On-call: Ability to participate in On-call rotation.

- On-site: This position requires daily onsite work at Truveta office in Hyderabad.

Qualifications

- Experience: 3-5 years of hands-on experience in an endpoint security, cybersecurity engineering, or similar role.

- Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of modern operating systems (Windows, macOS) and their architecture, configuration and deployment in a large enterprise environment.

- Cloud Experience : Strong hands-on experience on Azure Cloud PC, VM, Azure Firewall and Azure Networking.

- MDM Expertise: Strong hands-on experience on Microsoft Intune and JAMF administration, such as device enrollment, OS upgrade/patch, configuration, profile.

- Policy Management: Define and assign compliance/security policies to ensure corporation devices meet organizational security standards.

- Application Management: Strong hands-on experience on applications control, deployment, patch and upgrade.

- EPM: Proven experience with industry-leading EPM platforms such as CyberArk and BeyondTrust to control user privileged access and provide advanced threat protection and vulnerability management.

- Networking: Solid understanding of TCP/IP IPv4/v6, experience of office network (Routing / Switching / WAN, Wi-Fi & Security) management and network security concepts.

- Security Principles: Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST, MITRE), threat intelligence, and incident response methodologies.

- Compliance: Experiences with SOC 2 Type 2, HITRUST, and ISO compliance frameworks. Interact with the compliance team to ensure the company compliant and remediate gaps during compliance finding and controls.

- Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication/presentation, ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Solid experience with endpoint management platforms (Jamf Pro, Intune)

- Proficiency in at least one scripting language (PowerShell, Python, Bash)
