QUALIFICATIONS:

- 7+ years of hands-on IT systems administration experience.

- Strong skills in macOS and Google Workspace.

- Hands-on expertise administering and automating Okta, including securing access with strong auth policies and end‑to‑end user lifecycle automation using Okta Workflows; scripting experience with Bash or Python is highly preferred.

- Sharp troubleshooting instincts across MDM, Okta and common SaaS applications.

- A solid grasp of cybersecurity fundamentals, including IAM, RBAC, least privilege and encryption.

- Experience managing a ticketing system, including ITIL Problem Management and creating and monitoring of SLAs.

- A track record of leading IT projects from upgrade to rollout with minimum supervision.

- Clear communication and a genuine interest in automating away busywork.

At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people areimmediatelyat risk.We are the global leader inxOTcybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understandwhat isat stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.

About the Role:

The Senior Security Endpoint Engineer owns the full lifecycle of endpoint security and management across Dragos. This is a dual-mandate role: you're responsible for keeping endpoints secureandfor making sure people canactually dotheir jobs. That means EDR coverage and detection fidelity matter just as much as patch compliance and deployment reliability - and staff experience is a first-class outcome alongside security posture. You'll operate at the intersection of security engineering and IT operations, collaborating closely with Infrastructure/Systems Engineering to ensure unified endpoint management doesn't create friction for the business. This isn't a pure security role - it owns the employee-facing endpoint experience end to end.

Own the complete endpoint lifecycle including provisioning, configuration, enrollment, refresh, and decommissioning across all supported platforms while maintaining standard build configurations and baseline images.Administer and optimize the endpoint detection and response (EDR) platform, including sensor deployment, detection tuning, and response policy optimization to reduce alert noise while preserving security effectiveness.Lead endpoint-focused incident response activities including triage, containment, forensic data collection, and post-incident review; develop and maintain incident response runbooks for endpoint threat scenarios.Establish and manage the endpoint patching program across operating systems and third-party software, define patch compliance SLAs by severity level, and coordinate patching efforts with Infrastructure and Systems Engineering teams.Administer the mobile device management (MDM) platform for corporate and BYOD devices, manage mobile configuration profiles, compliance policies, and ensure mobile endpoint visibility within security tooling.Act as the escalation point for complex endpoint issues beyond helpdesk capability, maintain user-facing documentation and guidance, and gather staff feedback to reduce unnecessary policy burden while preserving security controls.Build and maintain endpoint automation for configuration management, compliance verification, remediation workflows, and reporting; evaluate new endpoint tools and capabilities and contribute endpoint-focused priorities to the security engineering roadmap.Qualifications:

5-8 years of hands-on experience in endpoint security, endpoint management, or a combined security/IT operations role.Deep working knowledge of EDR platforms: deployment, tuning, policy management, and incident response workflows.Demonstrated experience managing endpoints across Windows, macOS, and Linux at scale.Hands-on MDM administration experience (corporate devices and/or BYOD) across iOS and Android.Practical experience with patch management programs including SLA definition, compliance tracking, and exception handling.Proficiency with scripting and automation (PowerShell, Bash, Python, or equivalent) for endpoint management and operational workflows.Familiarity with vulnerability management workflows and how endpoint patching integrates into the broader program.Strong written communication skills - you can document a configuration decision and explain a security risk to a non-technical audience without losing accuracy in either case.Compensation:

jobs.description:
Senior macOS System Engineer

$110000 - $125000 per year | Charlotte, NC | On-site | Permanent

A bit about us:

We are a large, established organization with a diverse portfolio of businesses and a global technology environment. Our enterprise technology teams build and support the secure, reliable, and modern platforms that enable employees to work effectively across locations and business units.

The Endpoint Engineering team is responsible for delivering scalable device-management solutions, strengthening endpoint security, and modernizing the employee technology experience. The team works closely with Information Security, Infrastructure, Identity, Networking, and Support teams to ensure endpoint services remain secure, resilient, and aligned with evolving business needs.

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to serve as a senior technical authority for macOS engineering within a complex, large-scale enterprise environment. You will have the ability to shape endpoint strategy, lead modernization and automation initiatives, and influence how Apple devices are securely managed throughout their lifecycle.

You will join a collaborative technology organization where you can:

Take ownership of enterprise macOS engineering and platform architecture

Lead high-impact automation, security, and modernization initiatives

Work with modern endpoint-management and cloud-identity technologies

Solve complex technical challenges across a large, distributed environment

Partner with experienced professionals across Security, Identity, Infrastructure, and Networking

Mentor other engineers and help establish endpoint-engineering standards and best practices

Job Details

Position Overview

The Senior macOS Systems Engineer is responsible for engineering, maintaining, automating, and securing the organization’s macOS endpoint ecosystem and its supporting infrastructure. This individual will serve as a senior technical resource for macOS device management, endpoint security, automation, and enterprise client-engineering initiatives.

As a member of the Endpoint Engineering team, this role will focus on delivering scalable, secure, and modern management solutions for macOS devices across a global enterprise environment. Responsibilities include endpoint lifecycle management, operating-system deployment, application packaging, software distribution, patch management, security compliance, automation, and platform optimization.

The ideal candidate brings deep macOS platform expertise, strong engineering and scripting capabilities, and the ability to lead complex technical initiatives while maintaining the stability and reliability of critical endpoint services.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Engineering and Platform Management

Serve as the senior macOS subject-matter expert for endpoint-engineering operations, technical initiatives, and escalations.

Engineer, administer, maintain, and optimize enterprise macOS management platforms, including Jamf Pro and Iru.

Design scalable endpoint-provisioning and lifecycle-management workflows integrated with cloud-based identity environments.

Manage macOS operating-system deployment, configuration management, software distribution, and patch-management processes.

Establish and maintain standardized endpoint configurations across the enterprise.

Implement and enforce device-compliance policies and enterprise technology standards.

Evaluate platform capabilities and recommend improvements that enhance scalability, reliability, security, and the employee experience.

Automation and Scripting

Develop and maintain scripts, tooling, and automated workflows that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual administration.

Create and maintain application packages, deployment automations, and self-service software-delivery solutions.

Write advanced Bash and Python scripts supporting device provisioning, compliance, reporting, monitoring, remediation, and lifecycle management.

Identify opportunities to automate repeatable processes and improve the overall maturity of endpoint operations.

Build reliable and reusable solutions that can scale across a large enterprise environment.

Security and Compliance

Partner with Information Security teams to establish and maintain macOS security baselines and endpoint-hardening standards.

Engineer automated patching, vulnerability-management, and remediation processes.

Support endpoint-compliance programs and respond to critical vulnerabilities and security incidents.

Ensure endpoint-management platforms align with enterprise security, auditing, risk, and governance requirements.

Develop monitoring and reporting capabilities that provide visibility into endpoint health, vulnerabilities, and compliance status.

Infrastructure and Operations

Monitor the performance, availability, capacity, and overall health of endpoint-management platforms.

Troubleshoot and resolve complex macOS, endpoint-engineering, and supporting infrastructure issues.

Maintain and optimize platform architecture in alignment with business growth and operational requirements.

Lead or participate in platform upgrades, migrations, testing, validation, and enterprise rollout activities.

Proactively identify technical risks and implement solutions that improve platform stability and resilience.

Collaboration and Technical Leadership

Provide Tier 3 escalation support to Service Desk and technical support teams.

Collaborate with Infrastructure, Identity, Networking, Information Security, and other engineering teams to deliver integrated endpoint solutions.

Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate requirements and implement solutions supporting operational and strategic initiatives.

Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance across the Endpoint Engineering team.

Lead technical discussions, communicate recommendations, and help drive decisions related to macOS endpoint strategy.

Documentation and Standards

Create and maintain technical documentation, engineering standards, operational procedures, and platform-architecture materials.

Document configurations, integrations, automation workflows, troubleshooting procedures, and support processes.

Contribute to endpoint-engineering governance, best practices, and operational-maturity initiatives.

Ensure technical documentation remains accurate, accessible, and aligned with the current environment.

Qualifications

Required Experience

Five or more years of experience supporting and engineering enterprise macOS environments.

Five or more years of hands-on experience administering Jamf Pro, Iru/Kandji, or comparable Apple device-management platforms.

Experience managing large-scale endpoint environments supporting at least 1,000 users or devices.

Experience with modern endpoint-management platforms and cloud-based identity solutions.

Demonstrated experience leading complex endpoint-engineering, automation, or infrastructure-modernization initiatives.

Experience providing advanced technical support and resolving escalated enterprise endpoint issues.

Technical Expertise

Advanced knowledge of macOS administration, configuration, deployment, and troubleshooting.

Strong experience with Jamf Pro and Iru/Kandji architecture, administration, integrations, and ongoing maintenance.

Experience with macOS application packaging, software distribution, and deployment methodologies.

Advanced understanding of endpoint patch-management and vulnerability-remediation practices.

Strong scripting and automation experience using Bash and Python.

Working knowledge of Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment, and Apple MDM technologies.

Experience integrating endpoint-management platforms with identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID or Okta.

Knowledge of certificate-based authentication, conditional access, and modern identity-management concepts.

Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and the ability to troubleshoot endpoint connectivity issues.

Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or similar ticketing and workflow-management platforms.

Knowledge of endpoint-security best practices and modern cybersecurity principles.

Experience developing endpoint-compliance, monitoring, inventory, and reporting solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

Jamf Certified Tech certification or higher, including Jamf 200 or an equivalent current certification.

Apple platform or Apple device-support certifications.

Experience implementing cloud-first endpoint-management strategies.

Familiarity with Microsoft Intune and cross-platform endpoint-management environments.

Experience with automation frameworks, infrastructure-as-code practices, or API-driven integrations.

Experience supporting enterprise platform migrations or modernization programs.

Familiarity with zero-touch provisioning and identity-based device-enrollment workflows.

Key Competencies

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities

Automation-first engineering mindset

Ability to work independently within a complex enterprise environment

Strong technical communication and documentation skills

Ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent initiatives

Collaborative approach to cross-functional engineering and operations

Strong commitment to security, platform reliability, and operational excellence

Ability to balance long-term engineering improvements with immediate operational needs

Comfortable providing technical leadership and influencing decisions without direct authority

jobs.summary: The Application Analyst provides system analysis, configuration, maintenance, administration, and day-to-day support of assigned enterprise applications to ensure reliability, security, and high-quality service delivery across the MBTA. This role serves...
jobs.description:
The Application Analyst provides system analysis, configuration, maintenance, administration, and day-to-day support of assigned enterprise applications to ensure reliability, security, and high-quality service delivery across the MBTA. This role serves as a subject matter expert for functional and technical components of assigned platforms, troubleshooting issues, resolving incidents, and coordinating escalations with vendors and partner technology teams.

The Application Analyst monitors system performance, maintains documentation, supports upgrades, and ensures data integrity in alignment with organizational and regulatory requirements. This position also supports audits and compliance activities, and serves as a key liaison between IT, end-users, and business stakeholders, delivering responsive and professional service.

Digital Workplace

This role will focus on specialized Enterprise Application platforms that support the core workflows of our organization’s departments, such as Comply365, Microsoft Power Platform for workflow automation, HR, Learning, and Document Management systems, as well as related data integration between these and other enterprise systems.

This is a term-limited and project-specific contractor position that is not employed directly by the MBTA. This hybrid position requires being in the office at least two (2) days per week.Provide day-to-day application support for assigned platforms.

Troubleshoot and resolve application issues, including user access, synchronization, and performance problems.

Serve as a primary point of contact for application-related incidents, service requests, and user inquiries.

Serve as subject matter expert (SME) for all functional and technical aspects of the applications and associated technical components.

Partner with other team members on any application functional or technical issues or questions.

Provide third level support for application issues, including issues with application functionality, environment configuration, and / or system integrations.

Coordinate with relevant software vendor(s) to escalate and resolve complex issues.

Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement preventive measures.

Monitor system health and logs to ensure availability and reliability.

Assist with application upgrades, patches, testing, and release validation.

Collaborate with partner technology teams to ensure proper integration with other enterprise systems.

Develop and maintain application documentation, support procedures, and knowledge base articles.

Monitor and validate user access provisioning / deprovisioning, roles, permissions, and access controls.

Ensure data integrity and security within the platform, following organizational and regulatory standards.

Support audits and compliance activities related to application controls and regulatory requirements.

Participate in disaster recovery planning.

Handle sensitive and confidential information in an appropriate manner.

Respond to each inquiry, whether from a customer, vendor, or co-worker, in a courteous and professional manner

Participate in the on-call support rotation, responding to emergencies on a twenty-four (24) hour, seven (7) day per week basis while on-call.

Work any and all shifts and / or locations as assigned or directed, including occasional night and / or weekend work. · Perform all other duties and projects that may be assigned.

Additional responsibilities may include focus on one or more departments or locations. See applicable addendum for department or location specific functions.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Available to work any and all shifts and/or locations as assigned or directed.

Available to work as per assignment by the MBTA twenty-four (24) hours per day, seven (7) days per week as directed by supervisory staff for severe weather conditions, emergencies or any other circumstances that may potentially impact service or the safety of service.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No direct reports.

Minimum Education

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited instituition.

Three (3) years of experience in system analysis, including enterprise application design, configuration / development, implementation, and support.

Proven ability to map and document complex business processes and identify opportunities for optimization or automation within assigned applications.

Experience identifying and documenting business rules and technical requirements.

Foundational knowledge of cloud-based application delivery models such as Software as a Service (SaaS) and / or technology infrastructure concepts.

Experience with IT service management / ticketing systems.

Strong interpersonal skills to interact with stakeholders, vendors, team members, and end-users.

Ability to work with many different types of professionals in a fast-paced environment.

Ability to work effectively with a diverse workforce and end-user community.

Excellent attention to detail.

Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams).

Effective organizational, analytical, multi-tasking, time management, and documentation skills.

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts for end-users.

Excellent customer service and conflict resolution skills.

Experience with enterprise applications. Application expertise: Proven experience in the administration, configuration, and support of enterprise-level digital workplace applications (e.g., Comply365, Document Management System, Human Resources (HR), Learning Management System (LMS), Identity Provider (IDP), and Power Platform, etc.).

Power Platform Proficiency: Direct experience developing, governing, or administering solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate and/or Power Apps).

Integration Skills: Foundational knowledge and experience with Application Programming Interface (API) management, system connectors, or data integration tools/middleware.

Microsoft 365 Core Knowledge: Strong conceptual understanding of M365 governance, security, and integration points (SharePoint Online, Teams, etc.).

Compliance Application Deep Dive: Specific hands-on experience administering, configuring, or supporting Comply365 or similar enterprise-level Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) or Quality Management Systems (QMS).

Data and Reporting Tools: Experience using reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to extract meaningful operational and compliance data from the managed applications.

Analytics and Metrics: Experience defining, tracking, and reporting on key Digital Workplace KPIs, such as user engagement rates, service utilization, adoption progress, and platform Return on Investment (ROI).

Experience or interest in the public transit or transportation industry.

Substitutions

A high school diploma or GED with an additional seven (7) years of directly related experience substitutes for the bachelor’s degree requirement.

An associate’s degree from an accredited institution and an additional three (3) years of directly related experience substitutes for the bachelor’s degree requirement.

A master’s degree in a related subject substitutes for two (2) years of general experience.

A nationally recognized certification, or statewide/professional certification in a related field substitutes for one (1) year of experience.

Job Title: Endpoint Security Engineer III

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Employee Type: Regular

Type of Travel: Local

* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI has an exciting opportunity for an Endpoint Security Engineer to join our Transport & Cybersecurity Services (TCS) team in either Springfield, VA or St. Louis, MO.

Our Endpoint Security team is rapidly growing! This is one of several new positions that we have added to the TCS program. This is an exceptional opportunity for a TS/SCI cleared professional to join an incredibly talented team, work with cutting edge technologies, and propel your career within the Cyber realm!

TCS is a long-term, CACI Prime contract with the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) in support of the customer’s GEOINT mission. The Endpoint Security Engineer will support our Intelligence Community customer’s various endpoint security platforms. Positions on TCS require a TS/SCI clearance to be eligible for hire; with the ability to successfully pass a government polygraph as a post-hire requirement.

Responsibilities:
• Implement and apply technologies, processes, and practices designed to protect networks, devices, programs, and data from malicious attack, damage, or unauthorized access.
• Provide engineering and sustainment support for Carbon Black Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR).
• Establish computing environment by designing system configuration, directing system installation, and defining, documenting, and enforcing system standards.
• Provide specific, detailed information for hardware and software selection, implementation techniques, and tools for the most efficient solution to meet business needs, including present and future capacity requirements.
• Configure and install various security products utilizing Linux OS.
• Work with both the software vendor and the customer to research, analyze, and implement enterprise-wide security solutions/capabilities/enhancements to support customer business/mission goals and objectives
• Assist with design, analysis, testing and implementation of state-of-the-art secure architectures
• Oversee security infrastructure sustainment, maintenance, and advanced configuration (policy management, database administration and security management tools)
• Oversee the reporting, documentation and investigation of all security related incidents; lead the development and implementation of corrective measures

Qualifications:

Required:
• Active TS/SCI clearance. As a post-hire requirement, selected candidates must be able to successfully pass and maintain a government polygraph.

• Bachelor's degree (Engineering, Computer Science or related field). Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

• Minimum 5 years of technical experience in Cyber Security.

• DoD 8570 IAT Level II certified (current)
• Must obtain a CSSP Infrastructure Support certification within 6 months of hire date
• Working knowledge of maintaining Enterprise Cyber Security Engineering requirements utilizing the following tool: Carbon Black Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)
• Knowledge and experience in working with incident response and threat hunting solutions
• Strong hands-on working knowledge of administering applications in a Linux environment
• Experience with large-scale enterprise/global networks in a high-paced, diverse environment
• Understanding of and experience with the DoD Architecture Framework and other key DoD network architecture and strategic planning instructions
• Experience in providing status reports and products to senior management and customers
• Experience with plans, designs, and evaluations of security systems and architectures

Desired:
• CSSP Infrastructure Support certification
• Windows Enterprise Active Directory (AD) architecture and VMWare virtualization
• Strong hands-on working knowledge within an AWS Environment

-

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$75,200-$158,100

Job Summary

JCS Solutions is seeking a highly skilled Senior Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) Engineer to support the Defense Enclave Services (DES) program—an enterprise-scale digital modernization initiative for the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) and Department of Defense (DoD) Fourth Estate Agencies.

In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of modern endpoint management solutions, with a primary focus on Microsoft Intune and cloud-native device management. You will play a key role in migrating legacy environments (MECM and on-premises Active Directory) to Azure AD–joined, Intune-managed endpoints, helping drive secure, scalable, and user-centric solutions across the enterprise.

This position requires both deep technical expertise and the ability to collaborate across engineering, security, and operations teams to deliver resilient and compliant endpoint solutions.

jobs.description:
Overview
A career with Johnson County Government is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to serve a diverse and expanding community in meaningful ways. We challenge ourselves to be a different kind of government because we care deeply about our community and each other. Committed to our shared values, we provide excellent public service, seeking always to improve ourselves and our organization. We offer wonderful benefits, retirement plans, wellness incentives, a great organizational culture, and much more! If you’re searching for something more than just a job, something akin to a calling, then consider the challenge and opportunity of being a member of Johnson County Government!

Job Description
Johnson County's Department of Technology and Innovation (DTI) delivers innovative and reliable technology solutions and services to advance the objectives of County staff, elected officials, and the community in a cost effective and efficient manner. DTI is looking to fill the position of Endpoint Engineer (System Administrator I). This position will be part of the Endpoint Engineering team focused on ensuring all the supported endpoint devices, such as desktops, laptops, thin clients, and tablets, are proactively and strategically managed, and continues to be secure, patched, and supported.

Applications will be accepted through April 22, 2026.

The Endpoint Engineer (System Administrator I) position is responsible for software installations and deployments, patch management on endpoints, and overall client management. Additional duties include the following:

Establishes system specifications by conferring with users; analyzes workflow, access, information, and security requirements. Develops tactical solutions for routine system support, by resolving day-to-day problems for end users of Microsoft Active Directory and other 3rd party applications.
Confers with vendors; develops, tests, evaluates, and installs enhancements and new software. Develops system access; monitors, controls, and evaluates system performance for integrity of data through proper security groups, email distribution lists, external accounts, resource accounts and system permissions; maintains Active Directory user/email accounts through security requests and identifies unused accounts to ensure application of security practices and policies; establishes and tests disaster recovery policies and procedures; completes back-ups, restores information as necessary; maintains documentation.
Maintains system performance of physical and VMWare virtual servers by performing system monitoring, analysis, and performance tuning; installs and upgrades new Windows server hardware and software; applies patches, hot fixes and Service Packs; troubleshoots system hardware, software, networks and systems management; designs and runs system load/stress testing; escalates application problems to vendor.
Develops system access; monitors, controls, and evaluates system performance; establishes and tests disaster recovery policies and procedures; completes back-ups; maintains documentation. Plans, documents and implements projects for new technology and system functionality; coordinates work with other team members for timely completion; analyzes the network server infrastructure for capacity planning.

Job Requirements
Associate’s degree in the following field(s) of study: Information Technology or related field and two (2) years work experience in systems design, programming, systems software and support are required.

Experience with Microsoft Office 365, SCCM, Antivirus Administration, and aBachelor’s degree in the following field(s) of study: Information Technology or related field are preferred.

Experience can substitute for education.

Johnson County Government requires reference/background screening for all positions.

This position is currently eligible to work in a hybrid work environment with both onsite and remote work, after initial training period. Residency within the Kansas City-Overland Park-Kansas City, MO-KS Combined Statistical Area, which generally includes the Kansas counties of Johnson, Wyandotte, Leavenworth, Miami, and Linn, and the Missouri counties of Jackson, Clay, Platte, Cass, and Ray, is required.

Physical, Environmental, and Special Working Conditions:

All County employees may be called upon to assist other departments/agencies in a declared emergency situation.

The End User Computing Engineer will support, manage and oversee the day-to-day operations of Goodwill’s end-user computing environment consisting of desktop, mobile devices, printers, POS devices and peripherals across the enterprise.

RESPONSIBILITY LEVEL:

Implements strategies to achieve the goals for the organization and IT infrastructure environment. Implements, revises, and sustains policies, procedures and programs. Typically works on projects and initiatives that span 3 – 12 months.

The End User Computing Engineer will support, manage and oversee the day-to-day operations of Goodwill’s end-user computing environment consisting of desktop, mobile devices, printers, POS devices and peripherals across the enterprise. The desktop engineer also accepts ownership for various projects and implements initiative and assists in the design and planning of POS projects, while providing tier two/three support for other engineers and support team members.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES:

1. Provides strategic, innovative and cost-effective solutions to increase efficiency, reliability, and integration of our EUC services and operations.

2. Develops lifecycle and asset management processes.

3. Develops strategic management processes, including new application and upgrade evaluations.

4. Tests new or enhanced applications including systems enhancements and provides feedback.

5. Deployment of Windows using Microsoft Autopilot.

6. Project and Change Management: Effectively plans and manages own work to reliably complete routine job responsibilities and special assignments. May serve as a team member or subject matter expert on formal projects or within the department. Effectively engages in change affecting her/him, communicating appropriately with supervisor. Follows through on learning, skill building, and practice necessary to adapt to change.

7. Problem Solving: Light supervision; works independently. Periodic review of work by manager or senior coworker. Solves problems of moderate to advanced complexity; able to identify root cause, interpret data and resolve issues.

8. Technical Skill: Understands and applies professional principles and skills within area of specialization to modify processes to resolve situations.

9. Community Engagement: Champions Goodwill’s community engagement initiatives and serves as an ambassador for Goodwill in the wider community.

10. Complete all other duties/responsibilities as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS:

1. Associate’s degree or equivalent experience and 3-4 years experience.

2. Excellent customer service skills.

3. Experience with Active Directory

4. Proven ability to provision and troubleshoot O365 accounts.

5. Basic network troubleshooting skills.

6. Experience in Windows Autopilot services setup and deployment.

7. Deep knowledge in Software packaging and distribution using SCCM.

8. Must have reliable transportation, a valid driver’s license and proof of vehicle insurance, as this position may require some travel between locations and the transportation of equipment.

9. Legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

SKILLS:

1. Ability to work in a semi-autonomous and fast-paced environment.

2. Good Knowledge and experience in Intune configurations, policies and management.

3. Hands on experience in managing Windows Devices with co-management.

CORE CULTURAL COMPETENCIES:

1. Customer Focus: Independently anticipate and meet customer needs, while searching for ways to improve customer service. Internalize customer feedback, and follow up with customer to ensure problems are solved by providing innovative ideas to meet their future needs.

2. Values Differences: Seeks out the diverse perspectives and talents of others, striving to work effectively with others who have different perspectives, backgrounds or styles. Behave with sensitivity towards differences in cultural norms, expectations, and ways of communicating. Challenge stereotyping or offensive comments.

3. Communicates Effectively: Shares information and updates with others, while ensuring a clear, concise and professional communication through reports, documentation, written and other communications. Listens with interest to what others have to say.

4. Situational Adaptability: Demonstrates flexibility of responses to different situations through adapting to the changing needs, conditions, priorities or opportunities. Monitors how well an approach is working to see if a change is needed, recognizing cues that suggest a change in approach or behavior is needed.

5. Drives Results: Demonstrates a strong drive to achieve meaningful results, through driving tasks to successful completion and closure. Sets high standards for own performance, showing determination in the face of obstacles and setbacks.

6. Ensures Accountability: Takes responsibility and ownership for successes and failures in own work. Monitors progress of performance and changes approach accordingly, following through on commitments.

PHYSICAL/SENSORY DEMANDS:

Ability to remain stationary for extended periods. Repetitive use of hands is required in the form of fine manipulations while using a computer keyboard. Must be able to communicate effectively in verbal and written form. Vision is required to transfer written information into electronic databases. Prolonged periods of visual concentration are required. Ability to lift, push and pull a minimum of 50 pounds. Ability to travel between Goodwill locations as needed.

When determining placement within the salary range for this position Goodwill Greater Milwaukee & Chicago considers education, experience, internal equity, market demands and other qualifying criteria. It is not typical for individuals to be hired at or near the top of the rage for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on facts and circumstances of each case.

Certain roles are eligible to participate in an incentive plan. Participation in this plan does not guarantee an incentive payment and is subject to the terms and conditions of the plan, which are subject to change.

In addition to compensation, we offer a competitive benefit program that may include medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, retirement plan, paid time off (PTO) and more. The specifics of each benefit package will vary depending on factors such as full or part time jobs, contracted, temporary, or other job categories.

Company Overview

Arctiq is a global, intelligence-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking & Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data & AI, Autonomous Operations & Intelligence, and Enterprise Service Management. We help organizations operate, secure, and modernize complex environments by unifying infrastructure, networking, data, security, automation, and observability under a single, integrated operating model. Our work focuses on helping customers reduce operational friction, improve resilience, and make better, faster decisions as their environments evolve. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced End User Computing (EUC) Engineer to provide dedicated, full-time support. This role will serve as the primary resource responsible for the administration, support, optimization, and security of the organization's end-user computing environment.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise across modern endpoint management technologies and a proven track record of managing enterprise desktop environments, mobile devices, and endpoint security initiative

Qualifications

Administer and maintain enterprise endpoint management platforms, including SCCM/MECM and Microsoft Intune.Configure, deploy, and support Windows Autopilot for streamlined device provisioning and onboarding.Manage and support endpoint infrastructure through Windows Administration Center and related management tools.Package, deploy, and maintain end-user applications across the enterprise environment.Oversee operating system lifecycle management, including upgrades, migrations, and refresh initiatives.Manage endpoint patching and update compliance to ensure systems remain current and secure.Support and maintain endpoint backup and recovery solutions.Identify, prioritize, and remediate endpoint vulnerabilities in partnership with security teams.Administer software licensing and hardware asset management processes and reporting.Monitor and improve the overall digital employee experience, focusing on endpoint performance and user satisfaction.Implement and maintain endpoint security baselines, hardening standards, and compliance controls.Support and troubleshoot enterprise print services and printing infrastructure.Manage deployment and support of mobile applications across iOS and Android devices.Provide support for Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) programs and policies.Monitor endpoint health and performance through proactive monitoring and alerting solutions.Serve as the dedicated EUC resource, partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure reliable and high-quality end-user support.

Requirements

7+ years of experience in End User Computing, Desktop Engineering, or Endpoint Management roles.Hands-on experience administering Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) and Microsoft Intune in an enterprise environment.Strong experience with Windows Autopilot, endpoint provisioning, and device lifecycle management.Experience supporting enterprise Windows desktop environments and modern workplace technologies.Knowledge of endpoint security best practices, vulnerability management, and system hardening.Experience with application packaging, deployment, and patch management processes.Familiarity with mobile device management (MDM) solutions and mobile application deployment.Experience supporting BYOD environments and modern workplace initiatives.Strong troubleshooting, communication, and customer service skills.Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment while supporting a dedicated client account.Experience with enterprise monitoring and endpoint analytics platforms.Relevant Microsoft certifications related to endpoint management or modern workplace technologies.Experience working in managed services or dedicated client support environments.Familiarity with ITIL processes and service management best practices.

Arctiq is an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond, please let us know. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply.

We thank you for your interest in joining the Arctiq team! While we welcome all applicants, only those who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

Who we are:

Farm Credit Bank of Texas is a $42.2 billion wholesale bank that has been financing agriculture and rural America for over 100 years. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we provide funding and services to rural lending associations in five states, and we are active in the nation's capital markets.

While you may not be familiar with our name, Farm Credit Bank of Texas plays a critical role in supporting the businesses that make it possible for America to maintain access to an affordable and safe food supply, an industry which is one of the most innovative and evolving of our time. And while you help us deliver on our mission, we deliver on our commitment to you as a valued employee by providing competitive compensation, generous health and wellness benefits packages and an attractive workplace located along the bluffs of the Colorado River just minutes west of downtown Austin.

We seek out top talent in their fields, whether it be technology, finance, accounting, credit, human resources, or other administrative functions, and welcome you to join us in our mission to feed the world.

Position Description: The End-User Computing Engineer is responsible for supporting, enhancing, and securing the Bank's End-User Computing (EUC) environment. This role serves as a technical resource for the implementation, management, optimization, and troubleshooting of enterprise desktop technologies, virtual desktop infrastructure, endpoint management platforms, and related end-user services.

Working as part of the Information Technology team, the End-User Computing Engineer collaborates closely with Customer Support, Infrastructure Services, Information Security, and other technology teams to maintain reliable, secure, and efficient EUC services. The role provides advanced technical expertise, third-tier support, and engineering solutions that improve system performance, strengthen security, and enhance the overall user experience.

The position focuses on ensuring the availability, scalability, and security of the Bank's endpoint computing environment through proactive administration, automation, and continuous improvement. The End-User Computing Engineer leverages technical expertise to support modern workplace technologies, streamline operations, and deliver solutions that align with the Bank's business objectives and technology strategy.

Operating with a high degree of ownership and accountability, the End-User Computing Engineer identifies improvement opportunities, resolves complex technical issues, implements technology enhancements, and helps ensure that employees have secure and reliable access to the systems and tools they need to perform their work effectively.

Day-to-Day Duties and Responsibilities: Monitor and maintain enterprise EUC services to ensure acceptable levels of performance, reliability, and availability. Perform advanced troubleshooting, problem resolution, and preventative maintenance for desktop, endpoint, and virtual desktop technologies. Provide third-tier technical support and technical guidance to Customer Support and other IT teams. Administer and support desktop operating systems, endpoint management platforms, mobile devices, and related technologies. Enhance system security through endpoint hardening, vulnerability remediation, configuration management, and security-focused engineering practices. Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, standards, procedures, and operational support materials. Create and maintain automation solutions and scripts that improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and optimize operational processes. Manage assigned EUC systems and services, ensuring consistent performance, support, maintenance, and lifecycle management. Track work requests, operational activities, incidents, and project tasks through the Bank's IT service management processes. Communicate infrastructure updates, maintenance activities, and technology changes to management, support teams, and end users as appropriate. Support operating system and application deployment, patching, packaging, and update management activities. Collaborate with Information Security, Infrastructure Services, and application teams to support technology initiatives, compliance requirements, and continuous improvement efforts. Participate in the evaluation, testing, and implementation of new technologies that improve the employee computing experience and support the Bank's strategic objectives. What You Bring to the Team: Our ideal candidate has experience supporting enterprise end-user computing environments and enjoys working in a collaborative, customer-focused technology organization dedicated to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

This role requires a combination of endpoint engineering, systems administration, automation, troubleshooting, and customer service expertise, including:

Associate's degree, technical school certification, or equivalent technical experience. Professional certifications in Microsoft, Omnissa, VMware, or related technologies preferred. Three (3) or more years of experience as a Systems Administrator, Systems Engineer, End-User Computing Engineer, or similar technology role. Equivalent combinations of education, certifications, and experience may be considered. Experience administering enterprise Windows environments, desktop platforms, and endpoint management solutions. Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex technical issues. Experience supporting desktop operating systems, mobile devices, endpoint security, and end-user productivity tools. Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of service, accuracy, and attention to detail. Demonstrated ability to work independently while effectively collaborating across cross-functional technology teams. Commitment to operational excellence, continuous learning, and delivering high-quality technical support and engineering solutions. Preferred: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Experience with PowerShell scripting, automation, and systems management tools. Experience supporting virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), including Omnissa Horizon, VMware Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop environments. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and automated platform management. Experience with endpoint security technologies, vulnerability management, and remediation programs. Experience supporting Windows 11, Microsoft 365 applications, and modern workplace technologies. Experience with Windows Autopilot, device provisioning, and modern desktop deployment methodologies. Experience administering cloud-based computing environments, including Microsoft Azure. Experience with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) monitoring solutions such as ControlUp. Experience supporting collaboration and conferencing technologies including Microsoft Teams Rooms, Cisco Webex, and related platforms. Experience working within regulated financial services, banking, or highly controlled technology environments. Why Farm Credit Bank of Texas: In addition to a competitive salary, we offer comprehensive, affordable, and competitive benefit options that are focused on health and wellness, financial security, and achieving a work-life balance:

Flexible health-and-wellness benefits, including medical insurance, prescription drug coverage, dental insurance, vision care, flexible spending accounts, and more. 401(k) plan that includes immediate vesting of a generous employer match and additional employer contribution. Long-term disability and life insurance. Vacation leave, sick leave, and paid holidays. Fertility benefit and parental leave plan. Up to two days per year to volunteer in local community organizations, services, or events. Ongoing professional-development opportunities. Generous tuition-reimbursement program. Physical fitness incentive plan. Employer matching gifts program. Important note: We care about your hiring process and take it seriously. A real person will review your applications, meaning response timelines may vary. The interviewing process at Farm Credit Bank of Texas may include phone calls and emails, on-site interviews, and requests for portfolios or demonstrations of work. We can\'t personally follow up with each applicant, and we will do our best to create a professional, respectful, and thorough process for candidates with whom we identify as a potential fit.

Digital Workplace Engineer - Huntington Are you looking to join a successful and growing organisation who are committed to creating a great safe place to work where all employees have the opportunity to contribute, grow and develop? We are looking for a Digital Workplace Engineer to join our IT team in York.
As a Digital Workplace Engineer you will work collaboratively with internal stakeholders to build technology solutions that improve business processes.
You'll work at the sharp end of modern IT delivery designing, building, and supporting the digital tools and platforms that keep the business moving.
This is a chance to make a real impact: you'll collaborate with inspirational colleagues and get hands-on with the latest technologies whilst helping to shape a Digital Workplace that's fit for the future. If you're someone who thrives on solving problems and wants your work to genuinely matter, we'd love to hear from you.
Role Details:
Annual salary up to 50,000 dependent on skills and experience. Plus potential annual-on-target bonus of up to 5% subject to business performance
Role based: York, YO32 9PT (must live locally)
Contract type: Permanent
Annual leave of 25 days per annum plus bank holidays and opportunity to buy an additional 5 days each year.

In this role as Digital Workplace Engineer, you will be required to: Collaborate with technology architects and colleagues in multi-skilled project teams to deliver technical solutions in line with development standards and security policies.
Design, build and maintain technical solutions that support business requirements, supporting the achievement of business objectives, with particular focus on Microsoft M365.
Produce and maintain clear, comprehensive and up-to-date documentation for all solutions.
Analyse and improve existing solutions, applying best practices to enhance performance and reliability.
Engage with external suppliers proactively and assure the quality of solutions they develop and deliver.
Manage and resolve service requests and incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to business processes.
Liaise with stakeholders to review processes and design optimised solutions that improve efficiency and effectiveness.
Contribute to platform and application improvements, ensuring solutions remain fit for purpose.
Support Incident and Problem Management teams by investigating root causes and recommending preventative measures.

Benefits & Opportunities as Digital Workplace Engineer Contributory pension including life insurance benefit
A range of dedicated health and wellbeing services
Cycle to Work Scheme
Employee Benefits Program (Discounts at 100s of shops, gyms, restaurants and even holidays!)
Learning & development opportunities and resources
Opportunity for career progression
A chance to give back to your community with an annual volunteering day

Our Ideal Candidate as Digital Workplace Engineer Educated to degree level, or equivalent relevant experience.
Experience in building technical solutions within a systems development team.
Proven experience in developing and supporting Microsoft M365 technologies with exposure to some or all of the following:

Intune (AutoPilot, Configuration Profiles, Compliance Policies) for end-point and mobile devices Entra ID (Azure AD), MFA, Conditional Access and on-premise AD PowerShell for M365 and Azure administration Administration and development of MS Teams and Sharepoint PowerApp development Experience of working on multi-workstream projects.
Skilled in producing clear, accurate and up-to-date documentation.
Experience in analysing and improving existing technical solutions.
Knowledge of cloud technologies and modern integration platforms and techniques
Even if you do not match all of our ideal criteria we would still be very keen to receive your CV as we love developing our people and may feel that you could be developed into this role.
We are conducting interviews during, or before, the week commencing TBC.
NOTE: If we receive a high volume of applications for a role, we reserve the right to close a vacancy earlier than scheduled.

Salary: GBP 40000 per year

Experience: 2 years required

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are growing and expanding our Endpoint Management & Security product team and are looking for a Product Manager to join a group of PMs working together on the capabilities that power NinjaOne's approach to reducing attack surface, including risk analysis and remediation, across managed endpoints. This role reports to the Director of Product Management and operates as part of a highly collaborative PM team focused on building and evolving the tools IT and security teams rely on to keep endpoints secure and risk exposure low.

This role covers capabilities that sit at the intersection of IT operations and security, helping customers spot where they're exposed and take action to close those gaps before they become problems. While these capabilities are deeply technical in nature, this is a product role focused on defining the right features, workflows, and abstractions that allow IT teams and MSPs to identify, prioritize, and remediate risk across their endpoint fleet efficiently, safely, and at scale. We're looking for someone equally comfortable in IT operations and security contexts — candidates with a background in either (or both) are encouraged to apply.

You will work closely with engineering, design, and cross-functional partners to shape product direction, define roadmaps, and deliver high-impact capabilities that strengthen customers' security posture across their environments. You'll also collaborate closely with other Product Managers to ensure NinjaOne continues to lead the market in how modern endpoint management platforms are designed, used, and evolved.

If you enjoy building core product capabilities, working close to real-world IT and security use cases, and helping define what "great" looks like when IT operations and security work as one, we'd love to hear from you.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, *IL, KS, ME, MA, MD, NJ, NC, NY, OR, TN, TX, VA, & WA.

What You’ll be Doing

Product Vision & Leadership
Help define and evolve the vision for NinjaOne’s endpoint management and security capabilities, ensuring we continue to lead the market in functionality, usability, innovation and flexibility. Roadmap & Prioritization
Contribute to and own key parts of the endpoint management and security roadmap. Evaluate opportunities, set priorities, and make trade-offs that deliver the most value to customers and the business. Endpoint Management Capabilities
Drive product direction for features to identify security gaps, and remediate or protect against them.Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with engineering, design, support, and other stakeholders to bring new capabilities from concept to delivery, ensuring features are well-defined, usable, and solve real customer problems. Customer & Market Insight
Engage with customers, MSPs, and internal teams to understand how endpoint management and security features are used in practice. Translate those insights into product improvements and new capabilities. Product Craft & Execution
Write clear product requirements, define workflows and edge cases, and ensure features are delivered to a high standard. Iterate based on feedback and usage data. Platform & Ecosystem Thinking
Ensure capabilities work cohesively across NinjaOne and enable other product areas to build on top of them effectively. Other duties as needed

About You

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred, but not required. 5+ years of experience in IT/security or technical roles such as managing or working in an IT helpdesk, at an MSP, or in an internal IT/security team. 2+ years of Strong Product Management experience, ideally with B2B SaaS or IT management products. Solid background in operating systems or system administration, such as: Windows, macOS, or Linux administration Endpoint management, device configuration, automation, or scripting Experience in MSP, internal IT, or infrastructure-focused roles Deep understanding of how IT teams manage endpoints in real-world environments. Comfortable working closely with engineers and understanding technical concepts without needing to write production code. Proven ability to take product features from idea to delivery and iterate based on customer feedback. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Data-informed decision maker who balances customer needs, product quality, and business priorities. Able to influence and align stakeholders without formal authority. Experience working in a collaborative, multi-PM environment is a plus.

About Us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries. ​

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. ​ NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

What You’ll Love

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community.

We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.

We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.

We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.

We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.

We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

Additional Information

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

*Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate.

Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to location, market demands, experience, job-related knowledge, and skills. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage and PTO. For roles based in California, Colorado, Maryland, New Jersey or Washington the base salary hiring range for this position is $150,000 to $200,000 per year.

For roles based in New York, the base salary hiring range for this position is $150,000 to $200,000 per year.

\- BA + 10 years’ applicable experience, AA + 12 years’ applicable experience or 16 years’ experience

\- EntraID (AzureAD) experience

\- Solid knowledge of PowerShell scripting

We are seeking a hands-on IT professional to support endpoint deployment and management, user support, Microsoft 365 services, and office IT operations in a research and corporate environment.

The role also provides opportunities to develop automation solutions and participate in Linux, storage, and research computing initiatives.

Primary Responsibilities

Deploy, configure, and support Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints throughout their lifecycle, including provisioning, maintenance, and retirement
Manage employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including hardware deployment, software configuration, account provisioning, and access management
Administer and support Microsoft 365 services, including Active Directory, Entra ID, Intune, Teams, and Microsoft Defender
Provide first- and second-level technical support for endpoint, application, networking, and user-related issues
Maintain endpoint standards, inventory, deployment processes, and device compliance
Support datacenter operations, environmental monitoring and datacenter infrastructure systems
Support office IT infrastructure, including networking, printers, conference room technology, and Teams phone services
Develop and maintain automation solutions and operational tools using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies
Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and user guides

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
5+ years of IT systems administration, endpoint management, or IT operations experience
Strong experience deploying, configuring, and troubleshooting Windows desktop and laptop systems
Experience supporting Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Teams, and Microsoft Defender
Experience supporting and troubleshooting macOS systems
Experience managing endpoint lifecycle processes, including onboarding, deployment, maintenance, and retirement
Experience administering helpdesk or IT service management platform
Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoint, application, and networking technologies
Familiarity with networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VLAN concepts
Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, or similar tools
Excellent customer service, communication, and organizational skills

Experience supporting physical security, access-control, or facility management systems

Manual dexterity to operate tools, handle small components, and connect cables.

You may review, modify, or update your information by visiting and logging into the careers section of the system.

Job Description:
At Regions, the End User Computing (EUC) Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining desktop solutions that leverage various technologies and platforms. This role collaborates with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, design scalable and secure architectures, and ensure a smooth deployment and operation of desktop environments.
Responsibilities

Designs end-to-end desktop solutions by analyzing business requirements, assessing existing infrastructure, and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance architectures
Designs and integrates application and desktop products, including virtual apps and desktops, to provide comprehensive and cohesive desktop solutions
Configures and manages virtual machines, session hosts, virtual networks, and storage to create and maintain virtual desktop environments
Ensures proper image management, user profile management, and application delivery mechanisms
Designs and configures network connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and cloud serves, including network security measures, such as firewalls, VPNs, and load balancers, to ensure secure and efficient data transfer
Optimizes desktop environments for performance, scalability, and user experience
Monitors and tunes resource allocation, load balancing, and network bandwidth to ensure optimal performance
Implements security measures, including data encryption, access controls, and compliance requirements, to protect desktop environments and ensure compliance with industry regulations and organizational policies
Designs and implements high availability and disaster recovery solutions to minimize downtime and data loss
Creates redundancy mechanisms, backup strategies, and failover mechanisms to ensure business continuity
Assist with the set-up of monitoring tools and processes to proactively monitor desktop infrastructure
Identifies and troubleshoots performance issues, system errors, and network connectivity problems to maintain a stable and reliable environment
Creates design documentation, implementation guides, and operational procedures, policy documents and controls
Leads and coordinates with cross functional teams, to design and provide a timely resolution to all escalated issues related to the service. These cross functional teams include among others, support teams, agent owners, security and network teams and application SME's
Writes, tests, validates, and installs packages for software upgrades/patches
Provides support for incidents and problems escalated from our tier 1 and 2 support teams with a particular focus on PC hardware, operating systems, peripherals, and other issues

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field and four (4) years designing and implementing desktop solutions
Or High School Diploma/GED and eight (8) years designing and implementing desktop solutions
Experience in network design, including connectivity options, firewalls, VPNs, and load balancers

Preferences

Related certifications in A+, Azure, Citrix, Jamf, Microsoft technologies, etc.

Skills and Competencies

Ability to work with minimal supervision
Excellent customer service skills
Familiarity with identity and access management concepts
Knowledge of operating systems
Knowledge of security best practices, data encryption, access controls, and compliance requirements
Knowledge of systems automation tools including PowerShell, VB scripting, or Shell scripting
Knowledge of typical server applications and services, (SCCM, SQL, Active Directory, WSUS, GPOs, Jamf, etc.)
Knowledge of virtual desktop services
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conceptual skills
Strong verbal and written communications skills
Understanding of performance optimization techniques, monitoring tools, and troubleshooting methodologies

macOS & Jamf Pro Engineering Responsibilities

Implement and support Jamf Pro configurations including configuration profiles, policies, smart groups, inventory collection, and enrollment workflows.
Assist with Zero-Touch Provisioning for macOS using Automated Device Enrollment (ADE) through Apple Business Manager.
Apply and maintain macOS configuration baselines aligned with Bank security standards, CIS benchmarks, and MDM capabilities.
Create and maintain macOS packages, scripts, and automation to support software deployment, patching, and endpoint configuration.
Support integrations between Jamf Pro and enterprise systems such as identity providers, certificate services, and security platforms.
Participate in macOS version lifecycle activities including testing, validation, phased deployments, and user communications.
Leverage Jamf Pro APIs and built‑in tooling to support reporting, remediation workflows, inventory accuracy, and configuration compliance.
Develop and maintain scripts (bash, zsh, or Python) to assist with Jamf automation, macOS compliance checks, and provisioning tasks.

macOS Platform Knowledge

Demonstrated working knowledge of macOS system behavior including permissions, FileVault, MDM concepts, and security features.
Experience using Apple Business Manager capabilities such as ADE and VPP for application deployment and device lifecycle support.
Support macOS identity and authentication integrations, including certificates, SSO, and modern authentication methods.
Stay current with Apple platform updates and new capabilities, contributing recommendations to improve reliability, security, and user experience.

Troubleshooting & Operational Support

Serve as an escalation resource for macOS and Jamf Pro issues requiring advanced troubleshooting beyond standard support queues.
Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and identity teams to support standardized macOS endpoint management across the Bank.
Contribute to engineering documentation including build procedures, configuration standards, deployment guides, and operational runbooks.

Preferred macOS / Jamf Experience

Jamf certification at the 200 or 300 level (or equivalent hands-on experience).
Experience supporting macOS devices in enterprise or regulated environments.
Familiarity with macOS security tooling such as Jamf Protect, EDR platforms, certificate services, and OS hardening practices.
Exposure to integrating macOS into environments with Windows-centric tooling (e.g., Intune Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender).

The Endpoint Management Administrator is responsible for the deployment, configuration, maintenance, and lifecycle management of enterprise endpoint systems.
